translations.source: Kama wataalam wengine, ana shaka kuhusu kama ugonjwa wa kisukari unaweza kutibiwa, akagundua kuwa matokeo haya hayana umuhimu kwa watu ambao tayari wana ugojwa wa kisukari wa aina 1.

translations.source: USA Gymnastics hukubali barua ya Kamati ya Olimpiki ya Marekani na hukubali hitaji kuu la familia ya Olimpiki la kukuza mazingira salama kwa wanariadha wetu wote.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.
translations.hypothesis: USA Gymnastics has accepted the letter from the US Olympic Committee and agrees with the committee's primary goal of creating a safe environment for all of its athletes.

translations.reference: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
translations.hypothesis: We agree with the USOC's assessment that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, would be better served by making meaningful changes within the organization, rather than simply revoking credentials.

translations.reference: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.
translations.hypothesis: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shed light on how abuse at the highest levels, as vividly described by whistleblower Larry Nassar, was able to go undetected for so long, and embraces necessary and appropriate changes.

translations.source: USA Gymnastics na USOC zina lengo moja — kuifanya spoti ya sarakasi, na nyingine, salama iwezekanavyo ili wanariadha wafuate ndoto zao katika mazingira salama, chanya na ya kuwezesha.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.
translations.hypothesis: USA Gymnastics and USOC share the same goal: to ensure that the sport of gymnastics is as safe as possible, so that athletes can pursue their dreams in a safe, positive, and supportive environment.

translations.source: Katika miaka yote ya 1960, Brzezinski alimfanyia kazi John F. Kennedy kama mshauri wake na pia utawala wa Lyndon B. Johnson.

translations.source: Hii haithibitishi tu kuwa baadhi ya dinosaria walikuwa na manyoya, nadharia ambayo tayari imezagaa, bali pia inatoa maelezo ambayo kijumla visukuku haviwezi, kama vile rangi na mpangilio wa pande-tatu.

translations.hypothesis: Because dinosaur scales lack the characteristic "scute," which is a distinct feature of many reptiles, researchers have concluded that the scute may represent a later evolutionary development rather than a fundamental characteristic of dinosaur scales.

translations.reference: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.hypothesis: The structure of the feathers indicates that they were not used for flight, but rather for temperature regulation or display. Researchers suggest that, although this is a dinosaur feather, the sample shows evidence of a primitive feather structure, rather than the soft, downy feathers found in modern birds.

translations.hypothesis: The researchers suggested that, even though this is a small dinosaur fossil, the sample demonstrates feathers of a significant size, rather than the small, chicken-like feathers previously thought to be typical of dinosaurs.

translations.source: Mjadala ulianzishwa na mzozo juu ya kutumia zaidi kwa msaada na ujenzi upya katika Kimbunga Katrina; ambacho wahafidhina wa fedha wabebandika kwa ucheshi “Mpango wa Bushwa New Orleans.”
translations.reference: The debate was sparked by controversy over spending on relief and reconstruction in the wake Hurricane Katrina; which some fiscal conservatives have humorously labeled "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
translations.hypothesis: The debate was sparked by a dispute over the allocation of funds for aid and reconstruction following Hurricane Katrina; a point that conservative financial analysts jokingly refer to as the "Bush's New Orleans Plan."

translations.source: Ukosoaji huru wa juhudi za ujenzi upya umezingatia utoaji wa kandarasi za ujenzi upya kwa wajuzi wanaodhaniwa wa Washington.
translations.reference: Liberal criticism of the reconstruction effort has focused on the awarding of reconstruction contracts to perceived Washington insiders.
translations.hypothesis: The criticism of the reconstruction efforts has focused on the awarding of construction contracts to individuals believed to be connected to Washington.

translations.source: Watu zaidi ya milioni nne walienda Roma kuhudhuria mazishi.
translations.reference: Over four million people went to Rome to attend the funeral.
translations.hypothesis: More than four million people attended the funeral in Rome.

translations.source: Idadi ya watu waliokuwepo ilikuwa kubwa sana kwamba haikuwezekana kwa kila mtu kupata kuingia kwenye mazishi katika uwanja wa St. Peter.
translations.reference: The number of people present was so large that it was not possible for everybody to gain access to the funeral in St. Peter's Square.
translations.hypothesis: The number of people present was so large that it was impossible for everyone to enter the churchyard at St. Peter's.

translations.source: Skrini kadhaa kubwa za televisheni ziliangikwa mahali mbalimbali jijini Roma ili kuwezesha watu kutazama sherehe hiyo.
translations.reference: Several large television screens were installed in various places in Rome to let the people watch the ceremony.
translations.hypothesis: Several large television screens were set up in various locations throughout the city of Rome to allow people to watch the event.

translations.source: Katika miji mingine mingi ya Italia na ulimwengu kwa ujumla, haswa katika Polandi, mipangilio sawa ilifanywa, ambayo ilionekana na idadi kubwa ya watu.
translations.reference: In many other cities of Italy and in the rest of the world, particularly in Poland, similar setups were made, which were viewed by a great number of people.
translations.hypothesis: In many cities in Italy and around the world, particularly in Poland, similar arrangements were made, which seemed to accommodate a large number of people.

translations.source: Wanahistoria wameshutumu sera za zamani za FBI kwa kuangazia rasilimali kwenye kesi ambazo ni rahisi kutatua, hasa kesi za magari yaliyoibwa, kwa madhumuni ya kuongeza kiwango cha mafanikio cha wakala.
translations.reference: Historians have criticized past FBI policies for focusing resources on cases which are easy to solve, especially stolen car cases, with the intent of boosting the agency's success rate.
translations.hypothesis: Historians have criticized the FBI's past policies, which focused resources on cases that were relatively easy to solve, particularly car theft cases, in order to increase the agency's success rate.

translations.source: Bunge lilianza kufadhili kikundi chenye nia chafu katika mwaka wa kifedha wa 2005 na kuaini kuwa FBI lazima itoe makachero kumi kwa ponografia ya watu wazima.
translations.reference: Congress began funding the obscenity initiative in fiscal 2005 and specified that the FBI must devote 10 agents to adult pornography.
translations.hypothesis: Congress began funding a group with questionable motives in the 2005 fiscal year, and its aim was to compel the FBI to issue ten subpoenas for child pornography.

translations.source: Robin Uthappa alifanya alama za juu za fursa, pointi 70 katika mipira 41 kwa kufikia nne 11 na sita 2.
translations.reference: Robin Uthappa made the innings highest score, 70 runs in just 41 balls by hitting 11 fours and 2 sixes.
translations.hypothesis: Robin Uthappa scored a high number of runs, accumulating 70 points in 41 balls faced, with 11 fours and 2 sixes.

translations.source: Wachezaji wa kati wa kriketi, Sachin Tendulkar na Rahul Dravid, walicheza vizuri na kushirikiana katika masafa mia moja.
translations.reference: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, performed well and made a hundred-run partnership.
translations.hypothesis: The cricket midfielders, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, played well and collaborated effectively in the 100th over.

translations.source: Lakini, baada ya kupoteza wiketi ya kapteni India ilifanya pointi 36 na kupoteza wiketi 7 kumaliza fursa.
translations.reference: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.
translations.hypothesis: However, after losing the captain's wicket, they scored 36 points and lost the match by 7 wickets.

translations.source: Rais wa Marekani George W. Bush alifika Singapori asubuhi ya Novemba 16, hivyo kuanza ziara ya Asia ya wiki moja.
translations.reference: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long tour of Asia.
translations.hypothesis: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore on the morning of November 16, marking the start of a one-week trip to Asia.

translations.source: Alisalimiwa na Naibu Waziri Mkuu wa Singapori Wong Kan Seng na wakajadili masuala ya biashara na ughaidi na Waziri Mkuu wa Singapori Lee Hsien Loong.
translations.reference: He was greeted by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Wong Kan Seng and discussed trade and terrorism issues with the Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.
translations.hypothesis: He was greeted by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister, Wong Kan Seng, and discussed business and environmental issues with Singapore's Prime Minister, Lee Hsien Loong.

translations.source: Baada ya wiki ya kushindwa katika uchaguzi wa nusu muhula, Bush aliambia hadhira kuhusu upanuzi wa biashara katika Asia.
translations.reference: After a week of losses in the midterm election, Bush told an audience about the expansion of trade in Asia.
translations.hypothesis: Following a failed attempt to win the midterm elections, Bush addressed the public about the expansion of business in Asia.

translations.source: Waziri Mkuu Stephen Harper amekubali kutuma ‘Mkataba wa Hewa Safi’ wa serikali kwa kamati ya vyama vyote kwa ukaguzi, kabla ya kusomwa kwake kwa mara ya pili, baada ya mkutano wa Jumanne wa dakika 25 na kiongozi wa NDP Jack Layton kwenye PMO.
translations.reference: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO.
translations.hypothesis: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's "Clean Air Accord" to all party caucuses for review before it is debated for a second time, following a 25-minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the Prime Minister's Office on Wednesday.

translations.source: Layton alikuwa ameomba mabadiliko ya mswada wa kimazingira wa wahafidhina wakati wa mkutano na PM, akiomba “uandishi upya wa undani na mkamilifu” wa mswada wa kimazingira wa chama cha Wahafidhina.
translations.reference: Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a "thorough and complete rewriting" of the Conservative party's environmental bill.
translations.hypothesis: Layton had requested changes to the Conservative party's environmental bill during his meeting with the Prime Minister, asking for a "thorough and complete revision" of the bill.

translations.source: Tangu Serikali ya Shirikisho ilipoingilia kati kuhusu ufadhili wa hospitali ya Mersey katika Davenport, Tasmania, serikali ya jimbo na baadhi ya wabunge wa shirikisho wameshutumu kitendo hiki kama sarakasi kabla ya uchaguzi wa kishirika utakaofanyika mnamo Novemba.
translations.reference: Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November.
translations.hypothesis: Since the federal government intervened in the funding of the Mersey Hospital in Davenport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have condemned the move as a cynical attempt to influence the upcoming federal election.

translations.source: Lakini Waziri Mkuu John Howard alisema kitendo hicho kilikuwa tu cha kulinda majengo ya hospitali kutokana na kushushwa hadhi na serikali ya Tasmania, kwa kutoa dola milioni 45 za Australia.
translations.reference: But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million.
translations.hypothesis: However, Prime Minister John Howard stated that the action was simply to protect the hospital buildings due to a reduction in funding by the Tasmanian government, which amounted to 45 million Australian dollars.

translations.source: Kulingana na taarifa za hivi punde, vipimo vya kiwango cha bahari vilionyesha tufani ilizalishwa. Kulikuwa na baadhi ya shughuli dhahiri za tufani zilizorekodiwa karibu na Pago Pago na Niue.
translations.reference: According to the latest bulletin, sea level readings indicated a tsunami was generated. There was some definite tsunami activity recorded near Pago Pago and Niue.
translations.hypothesis: According to the latest reports, sea level measurements indicated a significant storm. There were also clear signs of a storm near Pago Pago and Niue.

translations.source: Hakuna madhara makubwa au majeraha yaliyoripotiwa huko Tonga, lakini nguvu za umeme zilipotea kwa muda, hali ambayo iliripotiwa kuzuia mamlaka ya Tongan kupokea onyo la tsunami lililotolewa na PTWC.
translations.reference: No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC.
translations.hypothesis: There have been no major damages or injuries reported in Tonga, but the power supply was disrupted for a period of time, which authorities believe may have prevented the Tongan government from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center (PTWC).

translations.source: Shule kumi na nne katika Hawaii zilizoko au zilizo karibu na mipaka ya pwani zilifungwa siku nzima Jumatano licha ya tahadhari kuondolewa.
translations.reference: Fourteen schools in Hawaii located on or near coastlines were closed all of Wednesday despite the warnings being lifted.
translations.hypothesis: Fourteen schools in Hawaii, located either on or near the coast, were closed for the entire day on Wednesday, despite the lifting of the alert.

translations.source: Rais wa marekani George W. Bush alikaribisha tangazo hilo.
translations.reference: U.S. President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.
translations.hypothesis: US President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.

translations.source: Msemaji wa Bush Gordon Johndroe alitaja ahadi ya Korea Kaskazini kama “hatua kuu kuelekea lengo la kufikia uondoaji wa kuaminika wa silaha za kinyuklia katika rasi ya Kikorea.”
translations.reference: Bush spokesman Gordon Johndroe called North Korea's pledge "a major step towards the goal of achieving the verifiable denuclearization of the Korean peninsula."
translations.hypothesis: According to Bush's spokesperson, Gordon Johndroe, the North Korean offer is seen as "a major step towards the goal of achieving verifiable disarmament of nuclear weapons in the Korean peninsula."

translations.source: Dhoruba ya kumi iliyopewa jina ya msimu wa Kimbunga cha Atlantiki, Dhoruba ya Nusutropiki ya Jerry, iliundwa katika Bahari ya Atlantiki leo.
translations.reference: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic Hurricane season, Subtropical Storm Jerry, formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.
translations.hypothesis: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic hurricane season, Tropical Storm Jerry, has formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.

translations.source: Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Vimbunga (NHC) kinasema kwamba wakati huu, Jerry hakitoi tishio kwa ardhi.

translations.hypothesis: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) states that at this time, Jerry does not pose a threat to land.

translations.source: Corps of Engineers cha Marekani kilikadiria kwamba inchi 6 za mvua huenda zikabomoa matuta ambayo yaliharibiwa awali.

translations.hypothesis: The U.S. Corps of Engineers estimated that 6 inches of rainfall could wash away debris that had previously damaged the structure.

translations.source: Wadi ya Tisa, ambayo ilishuhudia mafuriko ya hadi futi 20 kwa kimo wakati wa Kimbunga Katrina, sasa iko kwenye maji yanayofikia kiunoni kwani tuta lililokuwa karibu lilifurika.

translations.reference: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over the deletions when he spoke to Wikinews last month.
translations.hypothesis: Commons administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his disappointment when he discussed the deletion with Wikinews last month.

translations.source: "Yeye [Wales] kimsingi alindanganya tangu mwanzo. Kwanza kwa kufanya kama hii ni kwa sababu za kisheria. Pili, kwa kujifanya alikuwa anatusikiliza, hadi saana yake ifutwe."

translations.source: Hasira ya jamii imesababisha juhudi za sasa za kutayarisha sera kuhusu kadiri ya ngono kwa wavuti ambayo inakaribisha mamilioni ya vyombo vya habari vilivyo na leseni wazi.

translations.source: Kazi iliyofanywa ilikuwa hasa ya nadharia, lakini programu ilitengenezwa ili kuiga mitazamo iliyofanywa ya galaksi ya Mshale.

translations.hypothesis: The effect that the team was seeking would have resulted from the gravitational forces between black holes and white dwarf stars.

translations.source: Kama vile mwezi unavuta nguvu duniani, na kusababisha mawimbi, vivyo hivyo ndivyo Njia ya Kimaziwa hutia nguvu kwenye giligili la alama ya Mshale.
translations.reference: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.
translations.hypothesis: Just as the moon exerts a gravitational pull on the Earth, causing tides, so too does the Milky Way exert a force on the constellation of the Great Bear.

translations.source: Wanasayansi waliweza kuhitimisha kuwa udusi mweusi unaathiri udusi mwingine mweusi kwa njia ile ile ya kawaida.

translations.source: Nadharia hii inasema kuwa dutu nyingi yenye giza inayozingira galaksi iko karibu na galaksi kwa aina ya mwangaza, na inatengenezwa kwa chembechembe nyingi ndogo.

translations.source: Kulingana na shirika la nyuklia la Japan, mionzi, cesiamu na iodini zimetambuliwa kiwandani.
translations.reference: According to Japan's nuclear agency, radioactive caesium and iodine has been identified at the plant.

translations.reference: Authorities speculate that this indicates that containers holding uranium fuel at the site may have ruptured and are leaking.
translations.hypothesis: The government anticipates that this indicates that the uranium-containing materials at the site may be contaminated and leaking.

translations.source: Dk. Tony Moll aligundua Kifua Kikuu Kinachokinza Dawa Kabisa (XDR-TB) katika eneo la KwaZulu-Natal, Afrika Kusini.
translations.reference: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Tony Moll discovered a highly drug-resistant form of tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the KwaZulu-Natal region of South Africa.

translations.reference: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Moll believes that some patients may have been infected with the insect at the hospital, and at least two of them were hospital staff.

translations.reference: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
translations.hypothesis: In one year, a person infected with the disease may infect 10-15 close contacts.

translations.hypothesis: However, the prevalence of XDR-TB within the entire group of people with tuberculosis still appears to be relatively low, with approximately 6,000 out of 330,000 people who have been infected with tuberculosis at some point in South Africa.

translations.source: Setilaiti, ambazo zote mbili zilikuwa na uzani wa zaidi ya pauni 1,000, na kusafiri kwa takribani maili 17,500 kwa saa, ziligongana maili 491 juu ya Dunia.
translations.reference: The satellites, both of which weighed in excess of 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.
translations.hypothesis: The two satellites, each weighing over 1,000 pounds and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.

translations.source: Bado wanajaribu kuamua kiwango cha ukubwa cha mgongano na jinsi Ulimwengu utaathirika.
translations.reference: They are still trying to determine just how large the crash was and how the Earth will be affected.

translations.source: Amri ya Kimkakati ya Marekani ya ofisi ya Idara ya Ulinzi ya Marekani inafuatilia vifusi.
translations.reference: The United States Strategic Command of the U.S. Department of Defense office is tracking the debris.

translations.source: Matokeo ya uchambuzi wa uchoraji yatatumwa kwenye tovuti ya umma.
translations.reference: The result of plotting analysis will be posted to a public website.

translations.source: Daktari aliyefanya kazi katika Hospitali ya Watoto ya Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania atashtakiwa kwa uuaji uliochochewa baada ya mamake kupatikana ameuawa katika buti ya gari lake Jumatano, mamlaka ya Ohio inasema.

translations.hypothesis: A doctor who worked at the Children's Hospital in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, is expected to be charged with vehicular manslaughter after his mother was found dead in his car on Wednesday, according to authorities in Ohio.

translations.source: Dk. Malar Balasubramanian, mwenye umri wa miaka 29, alipatikana katika Blue Ash, Ohio, kitongoji kilichoko takriban maili 15 kaskazini mwa Cincinnati akiwa amelala chini kando ya barabara akiwa amevalia tishati na nguo za ndani katika hali iliyoonekana kuwa ya matumizi ya dawa nyingi.
translations.reference: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, was found in Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb approximately 15 miles north of Cincinnati lying on the ground beside the road in a T-shirt and underwear in an apparently heavily medicated state.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, a 29-year-old man, was found in Blue Ash, Ohio, a neighborhood approximately 15 miles north of Cincinnati, lying unconscious next to a road, wearing only underwear and a jacket, in what appeared to be a state of heavy drug use.

translations.source: Aliwaelekeza maafisa kwenye Oldsmobile yake nyeusi ambayo ilikiwa kwa umbali wa futi 500.
translations.reference: She directed officers to her black Oldsmobile Intrigue which was 500 feet away.
translations.hypothesis: He directed the officers to his black Oldsmobile, which was approximately 500 feet away.

translations.reference: The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos.
translations.hypothesis: The disease is carried by pigs, and then transmitted to humans through mosquitoes.

translations.source: Mkurupuko huo umechochea serikali ya India kuchukua hatua kama kuwatuma wawinda nguruwe katika maeneo yaliyoathiriwa sana, na kusambaza maelfu ya mapazia ya mbu na kunyunyiza dawa za kuua wadudu.
translations.reference: The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides.
translations.hypothesis: The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to take action, including sending in teams of experts, distributing mosquito nets, and spraying insecticides.

translations.source: Vichupa milioni kadhaa vya chanjo ya uvimbe wa ubongo vimeahidiwa na serikali, ambavyo vitasaidia kuandaa mawakala wa afya kwa mwaka ujao.
translations.reference: Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year.
translations.hypothesis: The government has pledged to provide millions of doses of a new vaccine against brain tumors, which will help healthcare providers prepare for the coming year.

translations.source: Mipango ya kufikisha chanjo mwaka huu katika maeneo yanayojulikana kihistoria kuathirika sana ilicheleweshwa kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa fedha na kipaumbele cha chini ikilinganishwa na magonjwa mengine.
translations.reference: Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.
translations.hypothesis: Plans to administer vaccines this year in historically affected areas were delayed due to a lack of funding and insufficient prioritization compared to other diseases.

translations.source: Mnamo 1956 Slania alihamia Uswidi, ambako miaka mitatu baadaye alianza kazi katika Ofisi ya Posta ya Uswidi na akawa mchoraji wao mkuu.
translations.reference: In 1956 Słania moved to Sweden, where three years later he began work for the Swedish Post Office and became their chief engraver.
translations.hypothesis: In 1956, Slania moved to Sweden, where, three years later, he began working at the Swedish Postal Office and eventually became their chief artist.

translations.source: Aina ya homa ya ndege iliyo hatari kwa binadamu, H5N1, imethibitishwa kuambukiza bata mwitu aliyekufa, aliyepatikana Jumatatu, katika kinamasi karibu na Lyon mashariki mwa Ufaransa.

translations.source: Ufaransa ni nchi ya saba katika Jumuiya ya Ulaya kukabiliwa na virusi hivi; kufuatia Austria, Ujerumani, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Ugiriki na Italia.

translations.source: Ghambers alikuwa amemshtaki Mungu kwa "vifo, uharibifu na ugaidi uilioenea, wa mamilioni ya mamilioni ya wakaazi wa Dunia."
translations.reference: Chambers had sued God for "widespread death, destruction and terrorization of millions upon millions of the Earth's inhabitants."

translations.source: Kama matokeo, watendaji huvuta misokoto ya bangi kwenye jukwaa, na ukumbi wenyewe unawahimiza hadhira kushiriki.

translations.source: Spika wa awali Newt Gingrich, gavana wa Texas Rick Perry na Mbunge Michelle Bachmann walimaliza katika nafasi za nne, tano, na sita mtawalia.

This caused the California Highway Patrol officer who was directing traffic to pull the photographer over twice.

translations.source: Walinda amani wa Umoja wa Mataifa, ambao waliwasili Haiti baada ya mtetemeko wa ardhi wa 2010, wanalaumiwa kwa ueneaji wa ugonjwa huo ulioanza karibu na kambi ya kikosi hicho.

translations.source: Kulingana na shtaka hilo, uchafu kutoka kwenye kambi ya Umoja wa Mataifa haukutakaswa vizuri, hivyo kusababisha bakteria kuingia kwenye tawi la Mto Artibonite, mojawapo ya mito mikubwa sana ya Haiti.
translations.reference: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
translations.hypothesis: According to the charge, pollution from the UN camp was not properly contained, leading to bacteria entering the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest rivers.

translations.source: Hata hivyo, haidhaniwi zilisababisha uharibifu wowote wa gari.
translations.reference: However, they are not thought to have caused any damage to the shuttle.

translations.reference: Five minutes into the display a wind starts rolling in, about a minute later, the wind is reaching 70km/h... then the rain comes, but so hard and so large that it slaps your skin like a needle, then hail fell from the sky, people panicking and screaming and running over each other.

Then, the rain came, but with such force that it felt like needles hitting your skin. Finally, heavy hail began to fall from the sky, causing people to panic and seek shelter.

translations.source: Nilimpoteza dadangu na rafiki yake, na nikiwa njiani kulikuwa na watu wawili wenye ulemavu kwenye viti vya magurudumu, watu waliruka tu juu yao na kuwasukuma," Armand Versace alisema.

translations.source: Asidi sayanuri na melanini zilipatikana kwenye sampuli za mkojo kutoka kwa wanyamavipenzi waliokufa baada ya kula chakula kichafu cha wanyamavipenzi.

translations.source: Mchanganyiko wa fuwele hizi unalingana na wa zile zinazopatikana kwenye mkojo wa wanyamavipenzi walioathiriwa ikilinganishwa kutumia uchunguzi wa miale isiyoonekana (FTIR).

translations.hypothesis: The combination of these compounds is similar to that found in the urine of animals affected by the disease, as determined by non-destructive infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).

translations.source: Sijui kama unatambua hili au la, lakini nyingi ya bidhaa kutoka Marekani ya Kati ziliingia humu nchini bila kulipiwa ushuru.

translations.hypothesis: What I'm saying to people is that we should treat each other the way we want to be treated.

translations.hypothesis: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed a law that prohibits the sale or lending of violent video games to minors.

translations.source: Mswada huo unahitaji michezo ya video yenye vurugu inayouzwa katika jimbo la Kalifornia kuwa na lebo iliyoandikwa "18" na kufanya mauzo yake kwa watoto wadogo kuwa na adhabu ya faini ya dola 1000 kwa kila kosa.
translations.reference: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.
translations.hypothesis: The law requires that video games containing violent content sold in the state of California must have a label that reads "18" and that sales to minors should be subject to a fine of $1,000 per violation.

translations.reference: The eathquake struck Mariana at 07:19 a.m. local time (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).
translations.hypothesis: The earthquake struck Mariana at 7:19 AM local time (9:19 PM GMT on Friday).

translations.source: Ofisi ya udhibiti wa dharura ya Marianas Kaskazini ilisema kwamba hakuna madhara yaliyoripotiwa katika taifa.
translations.reference: The Northern Marianas emergency management office said that there were no damages reported in the nation.
translations.hypothesis: The Northern Mariana Islands' emergency management office stated that there were no reported damages in the territory.

translations.source: Pia, Kituo cha Onyo ya Tsunami cha Pasifiki kilisema kuwa hakukuwa na dalili ya Tsunami.
translations.reference: Also the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said that there was no Tsunami indication.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center stated that there were no signs of a tsunami.

translations.source: Polisi wa kitambo wa Filipino amewateka nyara watalii wa Hong Kong kwa kuteka basi lao katika Manila, mji mkuu wa Ufilipino.
translations.reference: A former Filipino policeman has kept Hong Kong tourists hostage by hijacking their bus in Manila, the capital of the Philippines.
translations.hypothesis: Filipino police have arrested several tourists from Hong Kong after they were found stealing a bus in Manila, the capital of the Philippines.

translations.source: Rolando Mendoza alifyatua bunduki yake ya M16 kwa watalii.
translations.reference: Rolando Mendoza fired his M16 rifle at the tourists.
translations.hypothesis: Rolando Mendoza fired his M16 rifle at the tourists.

translations.source: Mateka kadhaa wamenusuriwa na angalau sita wamethibitishwa kufa kufikia sasa.
translations.reference: Several hostages have been rescued and least six have been confirmed dead so far.
translations.hypothesis: Several people have been killed, and at least six have been confirmed dead so far.

translations.source: Mateka sita, wakiwemo watoto na wazee, waliachiliwa mapema kama vile wapiga picha wa Ufilipino.
translations.reference: Six hostages, including the children and elderly, were released early, as were the Filipino photographers.
translations.hypothesis: Sixteen people, including children and the elderly, were released early, similar to the Filipino journalists.

translations.source: Wapiga picha baadaye walichukua nafasi ya mwanamke mzee kwani alihitaji kwenda haja. Mendoza alivamiwa kwa risasi.
translations.reference: The photographers later took the place of an aged lady as she needed the lavatory. Mendoza was gunned down.
translations.hypothesis: Later, the photographers took over, as the elderly woman needed to use the restroom. Mendoza was shot.

translations.source: Liggins alifuata nyayo za babake na kujiunga na kazi ya udaktari.
translations.reference: Liggins followed in his father’s footsteps and entered a career in medicine.
translations.hypothesis: Liggins followed in his father's footsteps and pursued a career in medicine.

translations.source: Alijifunza kuwa mkunga na akaanza kufanya kazi katika Hospitali ya Kitaifa ya Wanawake ya Auckland mnamo 1959.
translations.reference: He trained as an obstetrician and began to work at the Auckland's National Women's Hospital in 1959.
translations.hypothesis: He learned the profession and began working at the Auckland Hospital for Women in 1959.

translations.source: Alipokuwa akifanya kazi hospitalini, Liggins alianza kuchunguza uchungu wa mapema wa uzazi katika muda wake wa ziada.
translations.reference: While he was working at the hospital Liggins began to investigate premature labor during his spare time.
translations.hypothesis: While working at the hospital, Liggins began to investigate early signs of pregnancy during his spare time.

translations.source: Utafiti wake ulionyesha kwamba kama homoni ingetumiwa, ingeongeza kasi ya ukuaji wa mapafu ya mtoto.
translations.reference: His research showed that if a hormone was administered it would speed up the baby's foetal lung maturation.
translations.hypothesis: His research showed that if the hormone were used, it would accelerate the growth of the child's lungs.

translations.source: Xinhua aliripoti kwamba wachunguzi wa serikali walipata vifaa vya 'sanduku nyeusi' vya kurekodi matukio kwenye ndege siku ya Jumatano.
translations.reference: Xinhua reported that government investigators recovered two 'black box' flight recorders on Wednesday.
translations.hypothesis: Xinhua reported that government investigators discovered "black box" recording devices on the plane on Wednesday.

translations.source: Mabondia wenzake pia walimuombeleza Luna.
translations.reference: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.
translations.hypothesis: Her friends also comforted her.

translations.source: Tommy Dreamer alisema, “Luna alikuwa Malkia wa kwanza wa Kukithiri. Meneja wangu wa kwanza. Luna aliaga dunia mnamo usiku wa miezi miwili. Kipekee kama alivyo tu. Mwanamke hodari.”
translations.reference: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."
translations.hypothesis: Tommy Dreamer said, "Luna was my first manager and the first female wrestler. She passed away two months ago. She was a truly remarkable woman."

translations.source: Justin “Goldust” Runnels ametoa maoni kwamba “Luna alikuwa mdhaifu kama mimi … labda hata zaidi … umpende na utamkosa… kwa matumaini yupo mahali pazuri.”
translations.reference: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."
translations.hypothesis: Justin "Goldust" Runnels has stated that "Luna was as much a villain as I am… perhaps even more so… and I admired her for it… hoping she's in a good place."

translations.source: Kwa watu 1,400 waliopiga kura ya maoni kabla ya uchaguzi wa 2010 wa shirikisho, wale wanaopinga Australia kuwa jamhuri waliongezeka kwa asilimia 8 tangu mwaka wa 2008.
translations.reference: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.
translations.hypothesis: Among the 1,400 people who participated in a pre-2010 election poll on the issue of Australia becoming a republic, those who opposed the idea increased by 8 percent since 2008.

translations.source: Kaimu Waziri Mkuu Julia Gillard alidai wakati wa kampeni ya uchaguzi wa ushirika wa 2010 kwamba aliamini Australia inafaa kuwa jamhuri mwishoni mwa utawala wa Malkia Elizabeth II.
translations.reference: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.
translations.hypothesis: Acting Prime Minister Julia Gillard stated during the 2010 parliamentary election campaign that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.

translations.source: Asilimia 34 ya walio kwenye uchunguzi wanashiriki maoni haya, kumtaka Malkia Elizabeth wa II awe malikia wa mwisho wa Australia.
translations.reference: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.
translations.hypothesis: 34% of those surveyed expressed this opinion, calling for Queen Elizabeth II to be the last monarch of Australia.

translations.source: Katika wingi wa kura, asilimia 29 ya wale waliofanyiwa utafiti wanaamini Australia inapaswa kuwa jamhuri haraka iwezekanavyo, huku asilimia 31 wakiamini Australia haipaswi kamwe kuwa jamhuri.
translations.reference: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.
translations.hypothesis: In a survey, 29% of those surveyed believe that Australia should become a republic as quickly as possible, while 31% believe that Australia should never become a republic.

translations.source: Aliyeshinda nishani ya dhahabu ya Olimpiki alikuwa amepangiwa kuogelea katika mtindo huru wa mita 100 na mita 200 na mbio tatu za kupokezana vijiti katika Michezo ya Jumuiya ya Madola, lakini kwa sababu ya malalamiko yake uzima wake umekuwa na shaka.
translations.reference: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.
translations.hypothesis: The swimmer who won the Olympic gold medal was initially scheduled to compete in the 100-meter and 200-meter freestyle events, as well as in the 4x100-meter medley relay at the Commonwealth Games, but his participation was questioned due to concerns about his eligibility.

translations.source: Hakuweza kunywa dawa zinazohitajika kutuliza maumivu yake kwani zimepigwa marufuku katika Michezo.
translations.reference: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.
translations.hypothesis: He was unable to take the necessary pain relievers, as they are prohibited in sports.

translations.source: Curtis Cooper, mtaalamu wa hisabati na profesa wa sayansi ya kompyuta katika Chuo Kikuu cha Missouri, amegundua nambari tasa kubwa zaidi kufikia sasa mnamo Januari 25.
translations.reference: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer science professor at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date on January 25.
translations.hypothesis: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and professor of computer science at the University of Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date, on January 25.

translations.source: Watu kadhaa walithibitisha uvumbuzi huo kutumia maunzi na programu tofauti kufikia mwanzoni mwa Februari na ikatangazwa mnamo Jumanne.
translations.reference: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.
translations.hypothesis: Several individuals independently developed this invention using different tools and software, and it was officially announced on Wednesday.

translations.source: Kuna uwezekano kwamba nyotamkia zilikuwa chanzo cha kusafirisha maji katika dunia, pamoja na vitu vilivyo na kaboni vinavyoweza kuunda protini na kusaidia uhai.
translations.reference: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.
translations.hypothesis: It is possible that stromatolites were the origin of transporting water on Earth, along with organic matter that could form proteins and support life.

translations.source: Wanasayansi wanatumai kuelewa jinsi sayari huundwa, hasa jinsi Dunia ilivyoundwa, kwani nyotamkia ziligongana na Dunia kitambo.
translations.reference: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists hope to understand how planets are formed, particularly how Earth was formed, given that it was likely formed through collisions with other celestial bodies in the past.

translations.source: Cuomo, mwenye umri wa miaka 53, alianza ugavana wake mapema mwaka huu na kutia saini mswada mwezi uliopita wa kuhalalisha ndoa za jinsia moja.
translations.reference: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
translations.hypothesis: Cuomo, who is 53 years old, began his term in office earlier this year and signed into law last month a bill legalizing same-sex marriage.

translations.source: Alitaja uvumi huo kama "mapayuko na upumbavu wa kisiasa".
translations.reference: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
translations.hypothesis: He dismissed the rumor as "political nonsense and foolishness."

translations.source: Alifikiria kugombea urais mnamo 2016.
translations.reference: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
translations.hypothesis: He had considered running for president in 2016.

translations.source: NextGen ni mfumo ambao Utawala wa Shirikisho la Anga unadai ungeruhusu ndege kutumia njia fupi na kuokoa mamilioni ya galoni za mafuta kila mwaka na kukata uzalishaji wa kaboni.
translations.reference: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
translations.hypothesis: NextGen is a system that the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) claims will allow aircraft to use shorter routes, saving millions of gallons of fuel each year and reducing carbon emissions.

translations.source: Hutumia teknolojia yenye msingi wa setalaiti kinyume na teknolojia ya kitambo yenye msingi wa radar ya ardhini ili kuwezesha wadhibiti wa trafiki ya anga kupata vyombo vya angani kwa usahihi zaidi na kuwapatia marubani taarifa za usahihi zaidi.
translations.reference: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
translations.hypothesis: It utilizes satellite-based technology, in contrast to traditional ground-based radar technology, to enable air traffic controllers to obtain more accurate information about aircraft in the air, and to provide pilots with more precise data.

translations.source: Hakuna usafiri wa ziada unaowekwa na treni za juu ya ardhi hazitasimama huko Wembley, na maegesho ya magari na vituo vya kuegesha na kusafiri havipatikani huko.
translations.reference: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
translations.hypothesis: There are no additional transportation options available for trains that run above ground, and there are no parking facilities or drop-off/pick-up areas at Wembley.

translations.source: Hofu ya ukosefu wa usafiri kulizua uwezekano kwamba mchezo huo ungelazimika kuchezwa nyuma ya milango iliyofungwa bila wafuasi wa timu hiyo.
translations.reference: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
translations.hypothesis: The fear of a lack of transportation may have led to the possibility that the game would have to be played behind closed doors without the presence of fans.

translations.source: Utafiti uliochapishwa Alhamisi katika jarida la Science uliripoti kuhusu kuundwa kwa spishi mpya ya ndege katika Visiwa vya Galapagos vya Kiekuado.
translations.reference: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
translations.hypothesis: A study published on Friday in the journal Science reported the discovery of a new species of bird in the Galapagos Islands.

translations.source: Watafiti kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Princeton katika Marekani na Chuo Kikuu cha Uppsala katika Uswidi waliripoti spishi hiyo mpya iligeuka katika vizazi viwili pekee, ingawa mchakato huu ulikuwa unaaminika kuchukua muda mrefu zaidi, kwa sababu ya kuzaana kati ya wenyeji shorewanda wa Darwin, Geospiza fortes , na wahamiaji shorewanda wa dungusi kakati, Geospiza conirostris.
translations.reference: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
translations.hypothesis: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported that this new species has only produced two generations, despite the fact that the process was believed to take longer, due to the interaction between the native Darwin's finches, *Geospiza fortis*, and the immigrant ground finches, *Geospiza conirostris*.

translations.source: Dhahabu inaweza kutengenezwa ikawa maumbo tofauti tofauti. Inaweza kuvingirishwa ikawa maumbo madogo.
translations.reference: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.
translations.hypothesis: Gold can be shaped into various different forms. It can also be hammered into thin sheets.

translations.source: Inaweza kuvutwa na kuwa waya nyembamba, ambayo inaweza kusokotwa na kusukwa. Inaweza kubabatwa au kufiringishwa kufanya bamba.
translations.reference: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.
translations.hypothesis: It can be pulled and formed into thin wires, which can then be twisted and shaped. It can also be woven or braided to create rope.

translations.source: Inaweza kutengenezwa nyembamba zaidi, na kukwamishwa kwenye metali nyingine. Inaweza kutengenezwa nyembamba zaidi hadi wakati mwingine ilitumika kupamba picha zilizochorwa kwa mkono zinazoitwa “miswada iliyoangazwa”.
translations.reference: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".
translations.hypothesis: It can be made thinner and used as a base for other metals. It has also been used to create delicate, hand-drawn illustrations known as "illuminated borders".

translations.source: Hii inaitwa pH ya kemikali. Unaweza kutengeneza kiashiria kutumia juisi ya kabichi nyekundu.
translations.reference: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
translations.hypothesis: This is called chemical pH. You can create an indicator using red cabbage juice.

translations.source: Sharubati ya kabichi hubadilisha rangi kulingana na uasidi au ubesi (ualkali) wa kemikali.
translations.reference: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
translations.hypothesis: The color of cabbage changes depending on the acidity or alkalinity (alkali) of the chemical environment.

translations.source: Kiwango cha pH huashiriwa na kiasi cha ioni za Hidrojeni (H katika pH) kwenye kemikali iliyofanyiwa jaribio.
translations.reference: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
translations.hypothesis: The pH level is determined by the concentration of hydrogen ions (H+) in the chemical being tested.

translations.source: Ioni za Hidrojeni ni protoni ambazo zilibambuliwa elektroni zazo (kwani atomu za Hidrojeni huwa na protoni moja na elektroni moja).
translations.reference: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
translations.hypothesis: Hydrogen ions are positively charged particles that have been stripped of their electrons (since hydrogen atoms have one proton and one electron).

translations.source: Funganya poda mbili kavu kisha, kwa mikono safi yenye unyevu, ziingize kwenye mpira.
translations.reference: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
translations.hypothesis: First, dry the two pieces of paper completely. Then, using clean, moist hands, mold them into a ball.

translations.source: Unyevu kwenye mikono yako utaguswa na tabaka za nje, ambayo utahisi ikiwa tofauti na kuunda ganda aina fulani.
translations.reference: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
translations.hypothesis: The moisture on your hands will be noticeable in the outer layers of your skin, which will feel different and create a distinct texture.

translations.source: Miji ya Harappa na Mohenjo-daro ilikuwa na choo cha kisasa katika karibu kila nyumba, kilichounganishwa kwenye mfumo tata wa maji taka.
translations.reference: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
translations.hypothesis: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had modern toilets in almost every house, connected to a complex sewage system.

translations.source: Mabaki ya mfumo wa maji taka yamepatikana kwenye nyumba za miji ya Kiminoa ya Crete na Santorini katika Ugiriki.
translations.reference: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
translations.hypothesis: Remnants of ancient drainage systems have been found in the Minoan settlements of Crete and Santorini in Greece.

translations.source: Pia kulikuwa na choo katika Misri, Uajemi na China ya kale. Katika ustaarabu wa Kirumi, wakati mwingine choo zilikuwa sehemu ya nyumba za bafu za umma ambapo waume na wake walichanganyika pamoja.
translations.reference: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
translations.hypothesis: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia, and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bathhouses, where men and women would use them together.

translations.source: Unapompigia simu mtu aliye mbali maelfu ya maili, unatumia satelaiti.
translations.reference: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
translations.hypothesis: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using satellites.

translations.source: Setilaiti iliyo angani hupata simu kisha inaiakisi tena chini, karibu papo hapo.
translations.reference: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
translations.hypothesis: The moon, high in the sky, receives sunlight, then reflects it back down to Earth, almost instantaneously.

translations.source: Setalaiti ilitumwa angani kwa kutumia roketi. Wanasayansi hutumia darubini angani kwa sababu anga ya dunia huvuruga sehemu ya nuru na mtazamo wetu.
translations.reference: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
translations.hypothesis: Satellites are launched into space using rockets. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth's atmosphere distorts light and our view.

translations.source: Huhitaji roketi kubwa yenye urefu wa zaidi ya futi 100 kuweka setalaiti au darubini angani.
translations.reference: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
translations.hypothesis: I don't need a large rocket that is over 100 feet long to launch a satellite or a telescope into space.

translations.source: Gurudumu limebadilisha dunia kwa njia za ajabu. Jambo kubwa zaidi ambalo gurudumu limetufanyia ni kutupatia uchukuzi rahisi na wa haraka.
translations.reference: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
translations.hypothesis: The wheel has transformed the world in remarkable ways. One of the most significant contributions of the wheel is the ability to provide easy and rapid transportation.

translations.source: Imetuletea treni, gari, na vifaa vingine vingi vya uchukuzi.
translations.reference: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
translations.hypothesis: It has brought us many forms of transportation, including trains, cars, and other vehicles.

translations.source: Chini yake kunao paka zaidi zenye mwili wa wastani ambao hula mawindo yenye mwili wa wastani kuanzia sungura hadi swara na kulungu.
translations.reference: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
translations.hypothesis: Below them are a variety of medium-sized cats, including those that eat medium-sized prey, ranging from squirrels and rabbits to birds and reptiles.

translations.source: Mwishowe, kuna paka wengi wadogo (wakiwemo paka huru vipenzi) ambao hula mawindo madogomadogo ambayo ni mengi, kama wadudu, panya, mijusi, na ndege.
translations.reference: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
translations.hypothesis: Finally, there are many small cats (including feral cats) that eat small prey, such as insects, rodents, and birds.

translations.source: Siri ya mafanikio yao ni dhana ya niche, kazi maalum ambayo kila paka anashikilia na inayomzuia kushindana na wengine.
translations.reference: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
translations.hypothesis: The key to their success lies in their specialized niche, a particular task that each cat excels at and that prevents them from competing with others.

translations.source: Simba ni baadhi ya wanyama wa jamii ya paka wanaopenda ujamii zaidi, na wanaishi katika vikundi vikubwa vinavyoitwa prides.
translations.reference: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
translations.hypothesis: Lions are a type of cat that are known for their social behavior, and they live in large groups called prides.

translations.source: Makundi ya simba yanatengenezwa na waume kati ya mmoja na watatu wazima wanaohusiana, pamoja na wengi wa kike kama thelathini na mashibli.
translations.reference: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
translations.hypothesis: Lion prides are formed by a male lion and a group of lionesses, typically ranging from one to three lionesses.

translations.source: Wanawake kawaida ndio uhusiana sana wao kwa wao, kwa kuwa familia kubwa ya madada na mabinti.
translations.reference: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
translations.hypothesis: Women typically have close relationships with each other, due to the large extended families and the presence of many sisters.

translations.source: Makundi ya simba hutenda kama makundi ya mbwa mwitu au mbwa, wanyama ambao kwa kushangaza ni sawa na simba (lakini si paka wengine wakubwa) kitabia, na pia ni hatari kwa mawindo yao.
translations.reference: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
translations.hypothesis: Lion prides behave like packs of wild dogs or wolves, which are surprisingly similar to lions (but not the larger feline species), and also pose a threat due to their predatory nature.

translations.source: Mwanariadha wa mambo anuwai, simbamarara anaweza kupanda (ingawa si vizuri), kuogelea, kuruka mbali sana na kuvuta kwa nguvu mara tano ya zile za mwanamume mwenye nguvu.
translations.reference: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
translations.hypothesis: This incredibly versatile athlete can perform a wide range of feats, including climbing, swimming, long-distance running, and lifting five times his own body weight.

translations.source: Chui yuko kwenye kundi moja (jenasi panther) na simba, lengau na chui wa America ya kusini na kati. Hawa paka wanne pekee ndio wanaoweza kunguruma.
translations.reference: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
translations.hypothesis: The cheetah belongs to the same family (panther) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four species are the only ones that can purr.

translations.source: Mgurumo wa simbamarara si kama mgurumo mkubwa wa simba, bali ni zaidi kama sentensi ya kemeo yenye maneno yanayotolewa kwa kelele.
translations.reference: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
translations.hypothesis: The buzzing of bees is not like the loud roar of a lion, but rather more like a series of buzzing sounds, similar to a chorus of bees.

translations.source: Paka mwitu hupenda kula wanyama wadogo. Hushika tumbili, nyoka, panya na ndege kama wanaweza. Karibu wanyama wote ambao paka mwitu huwinda ni wadogo kumliko.
translations.reference: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
translations.hypothesis: A wild cat enjoys eating small animals. It preys on rodents, snakes, birds, and other small creatures. All the animals that a wild cat hunts are typically small in size.

translations.source: Wanasayansi wanafikiria kwamba paka mwitu hufuata na kutafuta wanyama wa kula (windo) kwa harufu, kunusa ili kutafuta walikokuwa ardhini.
translations.reference: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists believe that wild cats follow and hunt prey (rodents) using their sense of smell, sniffing the ground to locate them.

translations.source: Wanaweza kuona vizuri sana kwa giza na maono ya usiku pia wanasonga kwa kimya sana. Ocelots huwinda mawindo yao kwa kujichanganya na mazingira yao kasha kurukia mawindo yao.
translations.reference: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
translations.hypothesis: They have excellent night vision and also move silently. Ocelots communicate with each other by scent marking and also by making soft, purring sounds.

translations.source: Wakati kundi dogo la vitu vilivyo hai (idadi ndogo) linatenganishwa na idadi kubwa walimotoka (kama wakipita juu ya milima au mto, au wakihamia kwenye kisiwa kigeni hivi kwamba hawawezi kurudi nyuma kwa urahisi) mara nyingi watajipata katika mazingira tofauti na walimokuwa awali.
translations.reference: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
translations.hypothesis: When a small group of living things (a small number) becomes separated from the larger population (such as when they cross a mountain or river, or migrate to a distant island from which they cannot easily return), they often find themselves in a different environment than they were originally.

translations.source: Mazingira haya mapya yana rasilimali tofauti na washindani tofauti, kwa hivyo idadi mpya ya watu itahitaji vipengele au mazoea tofauti ili kuwa washindani imara kuliko walichohitaji awali.
translations.reference: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
translations.hypothesis: These new circumstances present different resources and different competitors, so a new generation of people will need different skills or practices to be as competitive as previous generations.

translations.source: Idadi asili haijabadilika kamwe, bado wanahitaji mbinu zile zile za za awali.
translations.reference: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
translations.hypothesis: The original number never changes; they still require the same old strategies.

translations.source: Kwa muda, jinsi idadi mpya inavyoanza kuzoea mazingira yao mapya, wanaanza kuonekana zaidi na zaidi tofauti na idadi ile nyingine.
translations.reference: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
translations.hypothesis: Over time, as the new group adapts to its new environment, it becomes increasingly distinct from the original group.

translations.source: Mwishowe, baada ya maelfu au hata mamilioni ya miaka, wakazi hao wawili wataonekana tofauti sana kwamba hawawezi kuitwa spishi moja.
translations.reference: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
translations.hypothesis: Finally, after millions or even billions of years, these two species will appear so different that they cannot be considered to be the same species.

translations.source: Tunauita mchakato huu speciation, ambalo linamanisha uundaji wa spishi mpya. Speciation ni matokeo yasiyoweza kuepukika na sehemu muhimu sana ya mageuzi.
translations.reference: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
translations.hypothesis: We call this process speciation, which refers to the creation of a new species. Speciation is an inevitable outcome and a crucial part of evolution.

translations.source: Mimea hutengeneza oksijeni ambayo binadamu hupumua, na huingiza kabonidioksidi ambayo binadamu hutoa nje (yaani, kupumua nje).
translations.reference: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
translations.hypothesis: Plants produce oxygen, which humans breathe, and they absorb carbon dioxide, which humans exhale (in other words, breathe out).

translations.source: Mimea hupata chakula chao kutoka kwa jua kupitia usanisinuru. Pia hupatia kuvuli
translations.reference: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
translations.hypothesis: Plants obtain their food from the sun through photosynthesis. They also produce oxygen.

translations.source: Sisi hutengeneza nyumba zetu kwa mimea na kutengeneza nguo zetu kwa mimea. Chakula kingi ambacho sisi hula ni mimea. Bila mimea, wanyama hawawezi kuishi.
translations.reference: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
translations.hypothesis: We build our homes using plants and create our clothing from plant fibers. A large portion of our diet consists of plant-based foods. Without plants, these animals would not be able to survive.

translations.source: Mosasaurus ilikuwa mwindaji mkubwa wa wakati huo, kwa hivyo haikuogopa chochote isipokuwa Mosasaurus wengine.
translations.reference: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
translations.hypothesis: The Mosasaurus was a dominant predator of its time, so it was not afraid of anything except other Mosasaurs.

translations.source: Taya zake kubwa zilikuwa na zaidi ya meno 70 kali kama wembe, pamoja na seti ya ziada kwenye paa la mdomo wake, kumaanisha kwamba chochote kilichokutana naye hakingehepa.
translations.reference: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
translations.hypothesis: Its most striking feature was its over 70 sharp, whale-like teeth, along with an additional set on the roof of its mouth, meaning that anything it encountered would be easily crushed.

translations.source: Hatujui kwa kweli, lakini inaweza kuwa alikuwa na ulimi uliogawanyika. Lishe yake ni pamoja na kasa, samaki wakubwa, mosasau wengine, na labda anaweza kuwa kiumbe alaye wenziwe.
translations.reference: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
translations.hypothesis: We don't really know, but it's possible that he had a split tongue. His diet likely included snails, large fish, and other mollusks, and perhaps he was a creature that was shelled.

translations.source: Pia alishambulia chochote kilichoingia majini; hata dinosau mkubwa kama vile T. rex hangejimudu dhidi yake.
translations.reference: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
translations.hypothesis: He also attacked anything that entered the water; even a large dinosaur like T. rex would have been no match for him.

translations.source: Wakati nyingi ya vyakula vyao tunavifahamu, Warumi walikuwa na sehemu yao ya vitu vya karamu vya kushangaza au visivyo vya kawaida, pamoja na nguruwe mwitu, tausi, konokono, na aina ya panya inayoitwa dormouse
translations.reference: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
translations.hypothesis: While we are familiar with many of the foods they ate, the Romans had their own unique and sometimes unusual delicacies, including wild boar, dormice, dormice, and a type of mouse called a dormouse.

translations.source: Tofauti nyingine ilikuwa kwamba huku watu masikini na mwanamke wakila chakula chao huku wameketi kwenye viti, watu tajiri walipenda kuwa na karamu pamoja ambapo wangepumzika kwa upande huku wakila vyakula vyao.
translations.reference: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
translations.hypothesis: Another difference was that the poor would eat while sitting on chairs, while the wealthy preferred to have gatherings where they could relax and enjoy their meals.

translations.source: Milo ya kale ya Kiroma haingejumuisha vyakula vilivyoingia Uropa kutoka Marekani au kutoka Asia katika karne za baadaye.
translations.reference: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
translations.hypothesis: Ancient Roman diets did not include foods that came to Europe from America or Asia in later centuries.

translations.source: Kwa mfano, hawakuwa na mahindi, wala nyanya, wala viazi, wala kakao, na hakuna Mrumi wa zamani aliyewahi kuonja batamzinga.
translations.reference: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
translations.hypothesis: For example, there were no corn, tomatoes, potatoes, or beans, and no ancient Roman had ever tasted a mango.

translations.source: Wababeli waliwajengea kila mmoja wa miungu yao hekalu la msingi ambalo lilizingatiwa kuwa nyumba ya mungu huyo.
translations.reference: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
translations.hypothesis: The Babylonians built a central temple for each of their gods, which was considered to be the god's dwelling place.

translations.source: Watu wangeleta dhabihu kwa miungu na makuhani wangejaribu kushughulikia mahitaji ya miungu kupitia sherehe na tamasha.
translations.reference: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
translations.hypothesis: People would bring sacrifices to the gods, and the priests would attempt to meet the gods' needs through ceremonies and festivals.

translations.source: Kila kasri lilikuwa na uwanja wazi wa kasri na kisha mahali pa ndani patakatifu ambamo ni makasisi tu wangeweza kuingia.
translations.reference: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
translations.hypothesis: Each castle had a large courtyard, and within that courtyard was a private chapel where only the clergy were allowed to enter.

translations.source: Wakati mwingine piramidi maalum zenye umbo la mnara, zinazoitwa ziggurat, zilijengwa ili ziwe sehemu ya hekalu.
translations.reference: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
translations.hypothesis: Sometimes, specific pyramids with a tower-like shape, known as ziggurats, were built as part of a temple complex.

translations.source: Sehemu ya juu ilikuwa makao matakatifu ya mungu.
translations.reference: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
translations.hypothesis: The upper part was the sacred dwelling of the gods.

translations.source: Katika hali joto ya hewa ya Mashariki ya Kati, nyumba haikuwa muhimu sana.
translations.reference: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
translations.hypothesis: In the warm climate of East Africa, houses were not as essential.

translations.source: Sehemu kubwa ya maisha ya familia ya Kiebrania ilifanyikia nje.
translations.reference: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
translations.hypothesis: A large part of the life of the Hebrew family was spent outside the home.

translations.source: Wanawake walifanya mapishi kwenye yadi; stoo zilikuwa kaunta wazi tu zilizoelekea barabarani. Mawe yalitumika kujengea barabara.
translations.reference: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
translations.hypothesis: Women prepared food in the yard; the only visible signs of cooking were the open fires on the roadside. Stones were used to build the roads.

translations.source: Hakukua na misitu mikubwa kwenye ardhi ya Canaan, kwa hivyo mbao ziliuzwa kwa bei ghali mno.
translations.reference: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
translations.hypothesis: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so timber was very expensive.

translations.source: Greenland ilikuwa na watu chache. Katika Norse sagas wanasema kwamba Erik aliye Mwekundu alifukuzwa kutoka Iceland kwa mauaji, na wakati wa kusafiri Magharibi zaidi, aliipata Greenland na kuiita Greenland.
translations.reference: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
translations.hypothesis: Greenland had a small population. According to Norse sagas, Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and while traveling further west, he discovered Greenland and named it Greenland.

translations.source: Lakina licha ya ugunduzi wake, makabila ya Eskimo yalikuwa tayari yanaishi huko wakati huo.
translations.reference: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
translations.hypothesis: However, despite its discovery, the Inuit people were already living there at that time.

translations.source: Ingawa kila nchi ilikuwa ya 'Kiskandinavia', kulikuwa na tofauti nyingi kati ya watu, wafalme, mila na historia za Denmaki, Uswidi, Norway na Aislandi.
translations.reference: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
translations.hypothesis: Although each country was considered part of Scandinavia, there were many differences between the people, kings, customs, and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway, and Iceland.

translations.source: Iwapo umetazama sinema ya Hazina ya Kitaifa, huenda ukafikiri ramani ya hazina iliandikwa nyuma ya Tangazo la Uhuru.
translations.reference: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
translations.hypothesis: If you have watched the movie "National Treasure," you may have thought that the map of the treasure was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.

translations.source: Hata hivyo, hilo si kweli. Ingawa kuna kitu kilichoandikwa nyuma ya hati, si ramani ya hazina.
translations.reference: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
translations.hypothesis: However, that is not the case. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.

translations.source: Nyuma ya Tangazo la Uhuru kuliandikwa maneno “Tangazo halisi la Uhuru la tarehe 4 Julai 1776”. Maandishi hayo yako katika sehemu ya chini ya hati, juu chini.
translations.reference: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
translations.hypothesis: The phrase "A True Declaration of Independence on the Fourth of July, 1776" is written at the bottom of the document, in small, faint print.

translations.source: Wakati hakuna anayejua kwa hakika ni nani aliyeiandika, inajulikana kwamba hati hiyo kubwa ya ngozi (ina vipimo vya inchi 29¾ kwa inchi 24½) ilikunjwa kwa uhifadhi.
translations.reference: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
translations.hypothesis: Although the author's identity remains unknown, it is known that this large leather-bound document (measuring 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was carefully preserved.

translations.source: Kwa hivyo, kuna uwezekano kuwa nukuu liliongezwa liwe kama ishara.
translations.reference: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
translations.hypothesis: Therefore, it is possible that the quoted phrase was used as a signal or indicator.

translations.source: Utuaji siku ya shambulio na mapigano yaliyofuata yalikuwa yameweka huru kaskazini mwa Ufaransa, lakini kusini bado haikuwa huru.
translations.reference: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
translations.hypothesis: The declaration of independence on the day of the attack and the subsequent fighting had secured freedom in northern France, but southern France remained under control.

translations.source: Ilitawaliwa na Wafaransa wa “Vichy”. Hawa walikuwa watu wa Ufaransa ambao walikuwa wamefanya amani na Wajerumani mnamo 1940 na kufanya kazi na washambulizi badala ya kupigana nao.
translations.reference: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
translations.hypothesis: It was controlled by the French, known as the "Vichy" regime. These were French citizens who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and were collaborating with them instead of fighting against them.

translations.source: Mnamo Agosti 15 1940, Majeshi ya Kirafiki yalishambulia Ufaransa kusini, shambulio liliitwa "Operesheni Dragoon".
translations.reference: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
translations.hypothesis: On August 15, 1940, Allied forces launched an attack on France in the south, an attack known as "Operation Dragoon".

translations.source: Kwa kipindi cha majuma mawili tu vikosi vya Marekani na Ufaransa Huru vilikuwa vimekomboa Ufaransa kusini na vilikuwa vikielekea Ujerumani.
translations.reference: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
translations.hypothesis: For just two weeks, the American and Free French forces had been liberating France in the south and were advancing towards Germany.

translations.source: Ustaarabu ni utamaduni wa umoja unaoshirikiwa na kundi kubwa la watu wanaoishi na kufanya kazi kwa kushirikiana, jamii.
translations.reference: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
translations.hypothesis: Craftsmanship is a cultural practice shared by a large group of people who live and work together in a community.

translations.source: Neno ustaarabu hutoka katika civilis la Kilatini, ambalo linamaanisha ya kiraia, linalohusiana na civis la Kilatini, linalomaanisha raia, na civitas, linalomaanisha mji au jimbo la mji, na ambalo kwa namna fulani linaelezea ukubwa wa jamii.
translations.reference: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
translations.hypothesis: The word "civilization" comes from the Latin word "civilis," which means "relating to citizens," and is derived from "civis," which means "citizen," and "civitas," which means "city or town," and which, in a way, describes the scale of a community.
