translations.source: Majimbo ya miji hutanguliza mataifa. Utamaduni wa kistaarabu huashiria kupitishwa kwa maarifa katika vizazi kadhaa, wayo wa kitamaduni unaoendelea kukaa kwa muda na usambazaji wenye haki.
translations.reference: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
translations.hypothesis: City-states were the foundation of nations. The culture of refinement signifies the passing down of knowledge across generations, with established traditions and a fair distribution of resources.

translations.source: Tamaduni ndogo mara nyingi hutoweka bila kuacha ushahidi muhimu wa kihistoria na kukosa kutambuliwa kama ustaarabu barabara.
translations.reference: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
translations.hypothesis: Small cultures often disappear without leaving behind significant historical evidence, and without being recognized as a unique form of transportation.

translations.source: Wakati wa Vita vya Mapinduzi, majimbo kumi na matatu kwanza yaliunda serikali dhaifu ya kati – huku Bunge la Marekani likiwa ndiyo sehemu yake pekee – chini ya Vifungu vya Shirikisho.
translations.reference: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
translations.hypothesis: During the Revolutionary War, thirteen colonies initially formed a weak central government – with the Continental Congress serving as its sole body – under the Articles of Confederation.

translations.source: Kongamano lilikosa uwezo wowote wa kuweka ushuru, na, kwa sababu hakukuwa na mtendaji wa kitaifa au mahakama, lilitegemea mamlaka ya taifa, ambao mara nyingi hawakuwa na ushirikiano, kutekeleza sheria zake.
translations.reference: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
translations.hypothesis: The conferences lacked the authority to enforce taxes, and, since there was no national government or court, they relied on the authority of individual states, which were often uncooperative, to enforce their laws.

translations.source: Pia haikuwa na mamlaka ya kupuuza sheria na orodha za ushuru kati ya majimbo.
translations.reference: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
translations.hypothesis: It also lacked the authority to override state laws and tax regulations.

translations.source: Vifungu vilihitaji ridhaa ya pamoja kutoka kwa majimbo yote kabla ya kurekebishwa na majimbo yalichukulia serikali kuu kwa mzaha sana kiasi kwamba mara nyingi wawakilishi wao hawakuwepo.
translations.reference: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
translations.hypothesis: The clauses required unanimous consent from all members before being amended, and the members often treated the central government with contempt, to the point that their representatives were rarely present.

translations.source: Timu ya soka ya Italia, pamoja na timu ya soka ya Ujerumani ndiyo timu ya pili yenye mafanikio zaidi duniani na ilikuwa bingwa wa kikombe cha dunia cha FIFA mwaka wa 2006.
translations.reference: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
translations.hypothesis: The Italian and German national football teams are the second and third most successful teams in the world, respectively, and they were joint winners of the 2006 FIFA World Cup.

translations.source: Michezo maarufu ni pamoja na kandanda, mpira wa kikapu, mpira wa wavu, polo ya majini, mchezo wa uzio, raga, uendeshaji baiskeli, hoki ya barafu, hoki ya gogo na mashindano ya magari ya F1.
translations.reference: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
translations.hypothesis: Popular sports include soccer, basketball, volleyball, water polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, field hockey, and Formula 1 racing.

translations.source: Spoti za msimu wa baridi ni maarufu sana katika maeneo ya Kaskazini, ambako Waitaliano hushindana katika michezo ya kimataifa na ya Olimpiki.
translations.reference: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
translations.hypothesis: Winter sports are very popular in northern regions, where Italians compete in international and Olympic competitions.

translations.source: Japani humiliki visiwa karibu 7,000 (kikubwa zaidi kikiwa Honshu), hivyo kuifanya Japani kuwa kisiwa cha 7 kikubwa zaidi duniani!
translations.reference: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
translations.hypothesis: Japan owns approximately 7,000 islands (the largest being Honshu), making it the seventh-largest island nation in the world!

translations.source: Kwa sababu ya mafungu/vikundi vya visiwa Japani ilivyo navyo, mara nyingi Japani huitwa, kwa msimamo wa kijiografia, "funguvisiwa"
translations.reference: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
translations.hypothesis: Due to the archipelago structure of the Japanese islands, Japan is often referred to, from a geographical perspective, as an "archipelago".

translations.source: Taiwan ilianza nyuma kitambo katika karne ya 15 ambapo mabaharia wa Kiingereza wanaopita hurekodi jina la kisiwa hicho kama Ilha Formosa, au kisiwa kizuri.
translations.reference: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
translations.hypothesis: Taiwan's history dates back to the 16th century, when English sailors passing through the area recorded the island's name as Ilha Formosa, or "Beautiful Island."

translations.source: Mnamo 1624, kampuni ya Dutch East India ilianzisha msingi kusini magharibi mwa Taiwan, kuanzisha mabadiliko katika mazoea ya uzalishaji wa nafaka na kuwaajili wafanyakazi wa Kichina kufanya kazi kwenye mashamba ya mpunga na sukari.
translations.reference: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
translations.hypothesis: In 1624, the Dutch East India Company established a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating changes in agricultural practices and employing Chinese workers to cultivate rice and sugar cane.

translations.source: Mnamo 1683, vikosi vya nasaba ya Qing (1644-1912) vilichukua udhibiti wa maeneo ya pwani ya magharibi na kaskazini ya Taiwan na kutangaza Taiwan kama mkoa wa Milki ya Qing mnamo 1885.
translations.reference: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
translations.hypothesis: In 1683, the Qing dynasty (1644-1912) took control of the western and northern coastlines of Taiwan and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.

translations.source: Mnamo 1895, baada ya kushindwa katika vita vya kwanza vya Sino-Japani (1894-1895), serikali ya Qing yatia sahihi mkataba wa Shimonoseki, ambao kwao inadhihirisha uhuru juu ya Taiwan hadi Japani, ambayo inaongoza kisiwa hadi 1945.
translations.reference: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
translations.hypothesis: In 1895, following its defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signed the Shimonoseki Treaty, which ceded Taiwan to Japan, effectively ending Chinese control of the island until 1945.

translations.source: Machu Picchu ina mifumo kuu mitatu, kwa majina Intihuatana, Hekalu la Jua, na Chumba chenye Madirisha Matatu.
translations.reference: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
translations.hypothesis: Machu Picchu has three main sections, known as Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Three-Windowed Room.

translations.source: Nyumba nyingi kwenye kingo za majengo hayo tata zilijengwa upya ili kuwapa watalii taswira bora ya jinsi zilivyokuwa mwanzoni.
translations.reference: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
translations.hypothesis: Many of the houses on the perimeter of the complex were rebuilt to provide tourists with a better sense of how they originally looked.

translations.source: Kufikia mwaka wa 1976, asilimia thelathini ya Machu Picchu ilikuwa imerejeshwa na urejesho unaendelea hadi leo.
translations.reference: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
translations.hypothesis: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored, and the restoration work continues to this day.

translations.source: Kwa mfano, umbizo la upigaji picha tuli wa kawaida zaidi duniani ni milimita 35, ambayo ndiyo iliyokuwa saizi kuu ya filamu katika zama za sinema za kikale.
translations.reference: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
translations.hypothesis: For example, the most common film format used worldwide was 35mm, which was the standard film size during the early days of cinema.

translations.source: Bado inatolewa hadi wa leo, lakini kwa umuhimu zaidi uwiano wa kipengele chake umerithiwa na umbizo za kihisio cha picha za kamera za kidijitali.
translations.reference: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
translations.hypothesis: It is still produced today, but its significance has been superseded by the digital image formats used in modern cameras.

translations.source: Muundo wa 35mm kwa kweli, kwa kiasi Fulani unachanganya, 36mm kwa upana na 24mm kwa urefu.
translations.reference: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
translations.hypothesis: The 35mm format, to some extent, combines 36mm for width and 24mm for height.

translations.source: Uwiano-vipimo wa muundo huu (kugawa na kumi na mbili ili kupata uwiano rahisi zaidi wa namba kamili) basi husemekana kuwa 3:2.
translations.reference: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
translations.hypothesis: The ratio-to-dimension of this design (dividing by 12 to obtain a simpler ratio of whole numbers) appears to be 3:2.

translations.source: Miundo mingi ya kawaida (familia ya APS ya miundoi, kwa mfano) ni sawa na au takribani sawa na uwiano huu.
translations.reference: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
translations.hypothesis: Many common motifs (such as those belonging to the APS family) are similar to or approximately similar to this ratio.

translations.source: Sheria ya thuluthi inayotumiwa vibaya na kudhihakiwa mara nyingi ni mwongozo rahisi unaounda uwezo huku ukidumisha kiwango cha mpango katika picha.
translations.reference: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
translations.hypothesis: The third rule, which is often misused and disregarded, is a simple guideline that establishes authority while maintaining a sense of order and professionalism.

translations.source: Inasema kwamba mahali palipo na athari kubwa kwa mada kuu ni katika mkutano wa mistari inayogawanya picha kwa thuluthi wima na mshazari (tazama mfano).
translations.reference: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
translations.hypothesis: It is said that the location and effect of the main element are most evident in the arrangement of lines that divide the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).

translations.source: Katika kipindi hiki cha historia ya Ulaya, Kanisa Katoliki, ambalo lilikuwa tajiri na lenye nguvu, likawa chini ya uchunguzi.
translations.reference: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
translations.hypothesis: During this period in European history, the Catholic Church, which was wealthy and powerful, came under scrutiny.

translations.source: kwa zaidi ya miaka elfu moja dini ya Kikristo imefunga majimbo ya Uropa pamoja licha ya kuwa na lugha na mila tofauti. I
translations.reference: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I
translations.hypothesis: For over a thousand years, the Christian faith has united the countries of Europe, despite their diverse languages and customs.

translations.source: Nguvu zake zilizoenea kote ziliathiri wote toka mfalme hadi mtu wa kawaida.
translations.reference: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.
translations.hypothesis: Its influence spread throughout the land, affecting everyone from the king to the common person.

translations.source: Mojawapo ya kanuni kuu za Kikristo ni kwamba mali inafaa kutumika kupunguza mateso na umasikini na kwamba hazina za kifedha za kanisa ziko hapo hususan kwa sababu hiyo.
translations.reference: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
translations.hypothesis: One of the fundamental Christian principles is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty, and that the financial resources of the church are specifically intended for this purpose.

translations.source: Mamlaka kuu ya kanisa yalikuwa katika Roma kwa zaidi ya miaka elfu na uwepo huu wa mamlaka na pesa katika sehemu moja ulipelekea wengi kuuuliza kama itikadi hii ilikuwa ikitekelezwa.
translations.reference: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
translations.hypothesis: The central authority of the church was located in Rome, and this concentration of power and wealth in one place led many to question whether this system was truly functioning as intended.

translations.source: Baada tu ya kuzuka kwa uhasama, Uingereza ilianzisha kizuizi cha kinevi dhidi ya Ujerumani.
translations.reference: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
translations.hypothesis: Immediately following the outbreak of hostilities, Britain imposed a naval blockade on Germany.

translations.source: Mkakati ulikuwa na ufanisi, kukatisha vifaa muhimu vya kijeshi na kiraia, ingawa kizuizi hiki kilikiuka sheria ya kimataifa ambayo inakubaliwa kwa jumla iliyoratibiwa na mikataba kadhaa ya kimataifa katika karne mbili zilizopita.
translations.reference: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
translations.hypothesis: The strategy proved effective in disrupting vital military and civilian assets, although this action violated international law, which is widely accepted and has been codified in numerous international treaties over the past two centuries.

translations.source: Uingereza ilitega mabomu kwenye maji ya kimataifa ili kuzuia meli zozote kuingia sehemu nzima za bahari, hivyo kuweka hatari hata kwa meli zisizoegemea upande wowote.
translations.reference: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.
translations.hypothesis: The British navy deployed warships in international waters to prevent any ships from entering certain areas of the sea, thus creating a danger for ships regardless of their allegiance.

translations.source: Kwa kuwa kulikuwa na mwitikio mdogo kwa mbinu hii, Ujerumani ilitarajia majibu kama hayo kwa vita vyake ambavyo havijazuiliwa vya chini ya bahari.
translations.reference: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
translations.hypothesis: Since there was a limited response to this tactic, Germany expected similar reactions to its unprovoked attacks on naval targets.

translations.source: Katika miaka ya 1920, mtazamo wa raia na mataifa mengi uliotawala ulikuwa wa upatanisho na utengaji.
translations.reference: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.
translations.hypothesis: In the 1920s, the prevailing attitude in many countries was one of reconciliation and separation.

translations.source: Baada ya kuona mambo ya kuogofya na ukatili wa vita wakati wa Vita vya Kwanza vya Dunia, mataifa yalitamani kuepuka hali kama hiyo tena wakati ujao.
translations.reference: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.
translations.hypothesis: Following the horrifying and brutal realities of the First World War, nations desired to avoid a similar situation in the future.

translations.source: Katika mwaka wa 1884, Tesla alihamia Marekani kukubali kazi katika kampuni ya Edison katika Jiji la New York.
translations.reference: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
translations.hypothesis: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States to accept a job at Edison's company in New York City.

translations.source: Aliwasili Marekani na peni 4 tu, kitabu cha mashairi, na barua ya kupendekeza kutoka kwa Charles Batchelor (meneja wake katika ajira yake ya awali) kwa Thomas Edison.
translations.reference: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
translations.hypothesis: He arrived in the United States with only $4, a collection of proverbs, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his former supervisor) to Thomas Edison.

translations.source: Uchina ya kale ilikuwa na njia ya kipekee ya kuonyesha vipindi tofauti vya wakati; kila hatua ya Uchina au kila familia iliyokuwa mamlakani ilikuwa nasaba maalumu.
translations.reference: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
translations.hypothesis: The ancient Chinese system of timekeeping was unique, with each stage of Chinese history or each ruling dynasty having its own distinct method.

translations.source: Pia kati ya kila nasaba kilikuwa kipindi kisicho na msimamo cha majimbo yaliyogawanyika. Maarufu sana kati ya vipindi hivi ilikuwa enzi za Falme Tatu za ya Han na Jin.
translations.reference: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
translations.hypothesis: Also, during each dynasty, there was a period of instability and fragmentation of the various states. One of the most notable periods was during the Han and Jin Dynasties.

translations.source: Wakati wa vipindi hivi vita vikali vilifanyika kati ya waangwana wakipigania kiti cha enzi.
translations.reference: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
translations.hypothesis: During these intense periods of conflict, the contestants fiercely competed for a place in the final.

translations.source: Falme Tatu ilikuwa enzi yenye umwagaji damu zaidi katika historia ya China ya Kale, maelfu ya watu walikufa wakipigania kuketi kwenye kiti cha juu zaidi katika ikulu ya Xi'an.
translations.reference: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
translations.hypothesis: The three kingdoms period was the bloodiest in ancient Chinese history, with thousands of people dying in the struggle for control of the imperial city of Xi'an.

translations.source: Kuna athari nyingi za kijamii na kisiasa kama vile utumiaji wa mfumo wa metriki, mabadiliko kutoka kwa msimamo wa udikteta hadi ujamhuri, utaifa na imani kuwa inchi ni ya watu si ya mtawala mmoja pekee.
translations.reference: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
translations.hypothesis: There are numerous social and political consequences, including the adoption of the metric system, the transition from an authoritarian regime to a republic, and the development of a national identity based on the belief that the country belongs to its people, not to a single ruler.

translations.source: Pia baada ya Mapinduzi kazi ilikuwa wazi kwa waombaji wote wa kiume, hivyo kuruhusu waliojitakia makuu na wenye mafanikio kufaulu.
translations.reference: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, after the revolution, work opportunities were available to all male applicants, allowing those with experience and success to thrive.

translations.source: Vilevile kwa wanajeshi kwa sababu badala ya madaraka ya kijeshi kutegemea darasa sasa yanategemea sifa.
translations.reference: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
translations.hypothesis: Similarly, for the military, instead of relying on rank, the focus is now on individual merit and performance.

translations.source: Mapinduzi ya Kifaransa pia yalichochea wafanyakazi wengine wengi wa nchi nyingine waliokandamizwa kuanza mapinduzi yao wenyewe.
translations.reference: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.
translations.hypothesis: The French Revolution also inspired many workers in other countries who had been oppressed to begin their own revolutions.

translations.source: Muhammad alivutiwa sana na mambo zaidi ya maisha haya ya kawaida. Alikuwa akitembelea sana pango ambalo lilikuja kujulikana kama "Hira" katika mlima wa "Noor" (nuru) kwa kutafakari.
translations.reference: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
translations.hypothesis: Muhammad was deeply fascinated by the simple aspects of life. He frequently visited a cave that later became known as "Hira" on Mount Noor (light), where he would meditate.

translations.source: Pango lenyewe, ambalo lilinusurika nyakati, hutoa picha dhahiri ya mielekeo ya kiroho ya Muhammad.
translations.reference: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
translations.hypothesis: The very act of fasting, which has guided us through difficult times, provides a clear picture of Muhammad's spiritual path.

translations.source: Likiwa juu ya mojawapo ya milima kaskazini mwa Mecca, pango hilo limetengwa kabisa na ulimwengu.
translations.reference: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
translations.hypothesis: Located on one of the mountains north of Mecca, this cave is completely isolated from the outside world.

translations.source: Kwa kweli, si rahisi kupata kamwe hata kama mtu alijua ipo. Ukishaingia kwenye pango, umetengwa kabisa.
translations.reference: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
translations.hypothesis: In fact, it is not easy to find, even if someone knows it exists. Once you enter the cave, you are completely isolated.

translations.source: Hakuna kingine kinachoweza kuonekana ila anga safi na nzuri huko juu na milima mingi inayolizunguka. Ni machache sana ya dunia hii yanayoweza kuonwa au kusikiwa ndani ya pango hili.
translations.reference: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
translations.hypothesis: All that can be seen is a clear and beautiful sky above, with numerous mountains surrounding it. It is a rare sight to witness or experience from within this enclosure.

translations.source: Piramidi kuu katika Giza ndiyo ya pekee ya maajabu saba ambayo bado inasimama leo.
translations.reference: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
translations.hypothesis: The Great Pyramid of Giza is the only one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World that still stands today.

translations.source: Piramidi Kuu iliyojengwa na Wamisri katika karne ya tatu BCE ni mojawapo ya majengo makubwa yaliyojengwa kwa heshima ya Firauni waliofariki.
translations.reference: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
translations.hypothesis: The Great Pyramid, built by the Egyptians in the 3rd century BCE, is one of the largest structures ever built in honor of a deceased pharaoh.

translations.source: Kilima cha Giza, au "Giza Necropolis" katika Bonde la Wafu la Misri kina piramidi kadhaa (ambazo piramidi kuu ni kubwa zaidi), makaburi kadhaa madogo, hekalu kadhaa, na Sphinx kuu.
translations.reference: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
translations.hypothesis: The Giza plateau, also known as the "Giza Necropolis" in Egypt, features several pyramids (the largest of which is the Great Pyramid), several smaller tombs, several temples, and the Great Sphinx.

translations.source: Piramidi kuu iliundwa ili kumheshimu Firauni Khufu, na piramidi, makaburi na mahekalu mengine mengi madogo yalijengwa ili kuheshimu wake na wanafamilia wa Khufu.
translations.reference: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
translations.hypothesis: The Great Pyramid was built to honor Pharaoh Khufu, and numerous smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were constructed to honor him and his family.

translations.source: Alama ya "gubeti la juu" inaonekana kama V na "alama ya gubeti la chini" kama kibanio au mraba unaokosa upande wake wa chini.
translations.reference: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
translations.hypothesis: The "upper bracket" symbol looks like a "V", and the "lower bracket" symbol looks like a bracket or a square without its bottom side.

translations.source: Juu inamaanisha unapaswa kuanzia nchani na kusukuma uta, na chini inamaanisha unafaa kuanzia kwenye frog (mahali ambapo mkono wako unashikilia uta) na kuvuta uta.
translations.reference: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.
translations.hypothesis: "Up" means you should start with your hand on top of the rope and pull down. "Down" means you should start with your hand on the frog (the part of the rope where your hand holds it) and pull up.

translations.source: Upinde wa juu kwa kawaida huzalisha sauti tulivu, huku upinde wa chini ukiwa na nguvu na ni imara zaidi.
translations.reference: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
translations.hypothesis: High-pitched sounds are typically soft, while low-pitched sounds are loud and more resonant.

translations.source: Jisikie huru kuandika kwa penseli alama zako, lakini kumbuka alama za kuinama zilizochapwa ziko kwa sababu ya kimziki, kwa hivyo yafaa ziheshimiwe.
translations.reference: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
translations.hypothesis: Feel free to write with your preferred pen, but remember that the notes are intended to be permanent, so they should be treated with respect.

translations.source: Mfalme Louis XVI, Malkia Marie Antoinette, watoto wao wawili wadogo (Marie Therese mwenye umri wa miaka 11 na Louis Charles mwenye umri wa miaka minne) na dada ya mfalme Bibi Elizabeth waliojawa na hofu, mnamo Oktoba 6 1789 walilazimishwa kurudi Paris kutoka Versailles na umati wa wanawake wa sokoni.
translations.reference: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
translations.hypothesis: King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette, their two young children (11-year-old Marie Therese and 4-year-old Louis Charles), and the Queen's sister, Elizabeth, who were all filled with fear, were forced to return to Paris from Versailles, along with a large crowd of women from the market.

translations.source: Katika gari la kukokotwa, walisafiri kuelekea Paris wakiwa wamezungukwa na umati wa watu waliopiga nduru na kutoa vitisho kwa Mfalme na Malkia kwa sauti kubwa.
translations.reference: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
translations.hypothesis: In the carriage, they were traveling towards Paris, surrounded by a large crowd of people who were shouting and making threats against the King and Queen.

translations.source: Umati wa watu uliwalazimisha Mfalme Na Malkia kufungua madirisha ya gari lao.
translations.reference: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
translations.hypothesis: The crowd forced the King and Queen to open the windows of their car.

translations.source: Kwa wakati mmoja memba wa umati alipunga kichwa cha mlinzi mmoja wa kifalme aliyeuawa katika Versailles mbele ya Malkia aliyejawa na hofu.
translations.reference: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
translations.hypothesis: At one point, a member of the crowd struck the head of a royal guard who had been killed in Versailles before the Queen, who was visibly frightened.

translations.source: Matumizi ya kivita kwa ubeberu wa Marekani katika ushindi dhidi ya Ufilipino yaligharimiwa na watu wa Ufilipino wenyewe.
translations.reference: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.
translations.hypothesis: The use of racial propaganda by the United States in its victory over the Philippines was condemned by Filipinos themselves.

translations.source: Walilazimishwa kulipa kodi kwa serikali ya wakoloni ya Amerika ili kugharamia sehemu kubwa ya matumizi na riba juu ya dhamana zilizowekwa kwa jina la serikali ya Ufilipino kupitia nyumba za benki za Wall Street.
translations.reference: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
translations.hypothesis: They were forced to pay taxes to the colonial government of America, which were used to finance a large portion of its expenses and interest on bonds issued in the name of the Philippine government through Wall Street banks.

translations.source: Bila shaka, faida kubwa kutokana na dhuluma za muda mrefu za watu wa Ufilipino ziliunda mapato ya msingi ya ubeberu wa Marekani.
translations.reference: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
translations.hypothesis: Undoubtedly, the significant economic benefits derived from the prolonged exploitation of Filipino labor were a major factor in the development of American capitalism.

translations.source: Ili kuelewa templar ni lazima mtu aelewe muktadha ambao ulisababisha uundaji wa agizo.
translations.reference: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.
translations.hypothesis: To understand the Templar, one must first understand the historical context that led to its creation.

translations.source: Kipindi ambacho matukio yalitokea kwa kawaida hujulikana kama Enzi za Juu za kati, kipindi katika historia ya Ulaya katika Karne za 11, 12, na 13 (1000-1300 Baada ya Kristo).
translations.reference: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).
translations.hypothesis: The period during which these events occurred is known as the High Middle Ages, a period in European history during the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (1000-1300 AD).

translations.source: Enzi za Juu za Kati zilitanguliwa na Enzi za Mapema za Kati na kufuatiwa na Enzi za Mwisho za Kati, ambazo kwa mapatano zinaishia karibu 1500.
translations.reference: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.
translations.hypothesis: The Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, with the period roughly spanning from around 1500.

translations.source: Uainishaji wa kiufundi ni kishazi ambacho hujumuisha maoni anuai katika mazoezi, kutoka teknolojia shinikizi, au maendeleo ya kiteknolojia katika dhana kuwa hatma ya binadamu huendeshwa na mantiki ya msingi inayohusishwa na sheria za kisayansi na udhihirisho wake katika teknolojia.
translations.reference: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
translations.hypothesis: Technological determinism is a concept that encompasses various viewpoints, ranging from the influence of technology on human behavior to the idea that human destiny is shaped by fundamental logic related to scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.

translations.source: Tafsiri nyingi za udhibitisho wa kiteknolojia zinashirikisha maoni mawili ya jumla: kwamba maendeleo ya teknolojia yenyewe hufuata njia zaidi ya ushawishi wa kitamaduni au kisiasa, na teknolojia hiyo kwa upande ina "athari" kwa jamii ambazo ni za asili, badala ya hali ya kijamii.
translations.reference: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
translations.hypothesis: Many technological determinist arguments involve two main points: that technological development itself follows a path more influenced by cultural or political factors, and that the technology, in turn, has an "impact" on society that is inherent, rather than socially constructed.

translations.source: Kwa mfano, mtu anaweza kusema kwamba motokaa hupelekea ukuzaji wa barabara.
translations.reference: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
translations.hypothesis: For example, someone might argue that motorcycles contribute to road congestion.

translations.source: Hata hivyo, mfumo wa kitaifa wa barabara hufai kiuchumi kwa magari machache tu, kwa hivyo mbinu mpya za uzalishaji zinakuzwa ili kupunguza gharama ya umiliki wa magari.
translations.reference: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
translations.hypothesis: However, the national road system is only economically viable for a limited number of vehicles, so new production methods are being developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.

translations.source: Umiliki wa magari kwa wingi pia hupelekea matukio mengi ya ajali za barabarani, ambazo hupelekea uvumbuzi wa mbinu mpya katika matibabu za kutengeneza miili iliyovunjika.
translations.reference: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
translations.hypothesis: The widespread ownership of cars also leads to a high number of road accidents, which in turn drives the development of new techniques in treating broken bones.

translations.source: Uroma ulikuwa na kipengele kikubwa cha maamuzi ya kitamaduni yaliyochochewa na waandishi kama vile Goethe, Fichte na Schlegel.
translations.reference: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
translations.hypothesis: The Romantic movement had a significant impact on cultural decision-making, influenced by writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.

translations.source: Katika muktadha wa Uroma, jiografia ilifinyanga watu, na kwa mpito wa wakati mila na tamaduni zilizohusiana na jiografia zilizuka, na hizi, zikiwa zinapatana na hali ya jamii, zilikuwa bora kuliko sheria zilizolazimishwa kiholela.
translations.reference: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
translations.hypothesis: In the context of Roman society, geography played a significant role, and over time, customs and traditions related to geography emerged, which, in conjunction with the prevailing social conditions, often proved to be more effective than strictly enforced laws.

translations.source: Jinsi Paris inavyojulikana kama mji mkuu wa mitindo wa ulimwengu wa kisasa, Konstantinople ilichukuliwa kuwa mji mkuu wa mitindo wa Uropa ya kikabaila.
translations.reference: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
translations.hypothesis: As Paris is known as the center of modern fashion, Constantinople was considered the center of European fashion.

translations.source: Inajulikana kwa kuwa kitovu cha anasa ilianza takribani 400 A.D. na ilidumu hadi karibu 1100 A.D.
translations.reference: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
translations.hypothesis: It is known to have been a major center of pleasure and entertainment, with activity dating back to approximately 400 AD and continuing until around 1100 AD.

translations.source: Hali yake ilizorota wakati wa karne ya kumi na mbili hasa kwa sababu ya ukweli kwamba Wapambanaji wa kidini walikuwa wamerejea na zawadi kama vile hariri na viungo vilivyokuwa na thamani ya juu kuliko vile vilivyotolewa na masoko ya Bizanti.
translations.reference: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
translations.hypothesis: Its fortunes fluctuated during the 12th century, primarily due to the fact that religious orders were returning with valuable goods such as silk and spices, which were more valuable than those available in Byzantine markets.

translations.source: Ilikuwa wakati huu ambapo uhamisho wa Jiji la Mtindo kutoka Konstantinopo hadi Parisi ulifanyika.
translations.reference: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
translations.hypothesis: This was the period when the transfer of the capital from Constantinople to Paris took place.

translations.source: Staili ya Kigothi ilifikia kilele katika kipindi kati ya karne za 10-11 na karne ya 14.
translations.reference: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
translations.hypothesis: The Gothic style reached its peak between the 10th and 14th centuries.

translations.source: Hapo mwanzoni mavazi yaliathiriwa na tamaduni za Baizantini kutoka mashariki.
translations.reference: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
translations.hypothesis: Initially, the clothing was influenced by Byzantine culture from the east.

translations.source: Hata hivyo, kwa sababu ya njia hafifu za mawasiliano, mitindo ya magharibi ilibakia nyuma kwa miaka 25 hadi 30.
translations.reference: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
translations.hypothesis: However, due to the relatively slow communication methods, Western trends lagged behind by 25 to 30 years.

translations.source: Kuelekea mwishoni mwa Zama za Kati Uropa magharibi ilianza kuendeleza staili yao wenyewe. Mojawapo ya maendeleo makubwa zaidi ya wakati huo kama matokeo ya krusedi watu walianza kutumia vifungo kukazia nguo.
translations.reference: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
translations.hypothesis: As the late Middle Ages approached, Western Europe began to develop its own distinct style. One of the most significant developments of the time, as a result of increased trade and contact with other cultures, was the use of buttons to fasten clothing.

translations.source: Kilimo cha kujikimu ni kilimo ambacho hufanywa kwa uzalishaji wa chakula cha kutosha tu kukimu mahitaji ya mkulima na familia yake.
translations.reference: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.
translations.hypothesis: Subsistence farming is a type of farming that focuses solely on producing enough food to meet the needs of the farmer and their family.

translations.source: Kilimo cha kujikimu ni mfumo rahisi, aghalabu wa kikaboni, unaotumia mbegu zilizohifadhiwa na asilia kwa eneo husika, pamoja na mzunguko wa mimea au mbinu mbadala zilizo rahisi ili kuboresha mavuno.
translations.reference: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.
translations.hypothesis: Self-sufficiency farming is a simple, primarily organic system that uses locally sourced seeds and natural methods, along with straightforward crop rotation or alternative techniques, to improve yields.

translations.source: Kihistoria, wakulima wengi walijihusisha na kilimo cha kujikimu na hii bado ndiyo hali katika mataifa mengi yanayoendelea.
translations.reference: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
translations.hypothesis: Historically, many farmers have been involved in subsistence farming, and this practice remains common in many developing countries.

translations.source: Utamaduni mdogo huwaleta pamoja watu walio wa mafikira sawa na ambao wanahisi kuwa wametengwa na viwango vya kijamii na kuwaruhusu kuendeleza hisia za utambulisho.
translations.reference: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
translations.hypothesis: This subculture brings together people with similar interests and who feel alienated from mainstream society, allowing them to develop a sense of identity and belonging.

translations.source: Vikundi vidogo vya tamaduni vinaweza kuwa vya kipekee kwa sababu ya umri, kabila, daraja, eneo, na/au jinsia ya washiriki.
translations.reference: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
translations.hypothesis: Small cultural groups can be unique due to factors such as age, tribe, social class, location, and/or gender of their members.

translations.source: Sifa zinazofanya utamaduni mdogo kuwa wa kipekee huenda zikawa za kilugha, kiurembo, kidini, kisiasa, kijiografia au mchanganyiko wa vipengele.
translations.reference: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
translations.hypothesis: The unique characteristics of a small culture may stem from its language, aesthetics, religion, politics, geography, or a combination of these elements.

translations.source: Wanachama wa utamaduni mdogo mdogo kwa mara nyingi huashiria uanachama wao kupitia mitindo ya kipekee ambayo ni pamoja na mitindo ya kimavazi, tabia na lugha.
translations.reference: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
translations.hypothesis: Members of small, tight-knit communities often identify themselves through unique styles that include clothing, behavior, and language.

translations.source: Mojawapo ya mbinu maarufu zinatozumiwa kuonyesha umuhimu wa kushirikiana ni kutumia mifano michache sikitishi ya watoto ambao, kupitia mapuuza, mikosi, kunyanyaswa kimakusudi, hawakushirikishwa na watu wazima walipokuwa wanapokua.
translations.reference: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
translations.hypothesis: One of the most effective strategies for demonstrating the importance of collaboration is to use a few brief examples of children who, through neglect, abuse, and intentional harm, were not given the support and guidance they needed from adults during their formative years.

translations.source: Watoto kama hao huitwa "katili" au jeuri. Watoto wengine katili wamefungwa na watu (kwa kawaida wazazi wao wenyewe); katika hali nyingine huu kuachwa kwa watoto kulitokana na wazazi kukataa upungufu mkubwa wa kiakili au mwili kwa mtoto.
translations.reference: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
translations.hypothesis: Children like these are referred to as "abandoned" or "orphaned." Some abandoned children have been left in the care of others (usually their own parents); in other cases, abandonment results from parents' inability or unwillingness to provide adequate care due to intellectual or physical disabilities.

translations.source: Huenda watoto wasiotagusana walipitia unyanyasaji mkuu au kiwewe utotoni mwao kabla ya kuachiliwa au kutoroka.
translations.reference: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
translations.hypothesis: It is possible that children who have been missing for a long time have experienced severe abuse or neglect before going missing, or that they ran away.

translations.source: Wengine wanadaiwa kulewa na wanyama; wengine wanasemekana kuishi porini kivyao.
translations.reference: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
translations.hypothesis: Some are said to be nocturnal creatures; others are believed to live in caves.

translations.source: Anapolelewa kabisa na wanyama wasio wa kibinadamu, mtoto katili huonyesha tabia (ndani ya mipaka ya kimwili) karibu kabisa kama zile za mnyama mahsusi wa utunzaji, kama vile hofu au upurukushani wake kwa wanadamu.
translations.reference: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
translations.hypothesis: Raised by animals, the child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) very similar to those of a specific animal species, such as fear or aggression towards humans.

translations.source: Wakati elimu ya msingi wa mradi kunapaswa kufanya elimu kuwa rahisi na ya kupendeza zaidi, udungu huenda hatua zaidi.
translations.reference: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
translations.hypothesis: While the primary goal of the project should be to make education more accessible and enjoyable, adolescence may present additional challenges.

translations.source: Mbinu za mafunzo si njia ya kusoma lakini huduma ambayo hutoa usaidizi kwa watu ambao wanapitia hali mpya ya masomo kama vile kutumia programu mpya ya kompyuta au kuanza mradi mpya.
translations.reference: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
translations.hypothesis: Training strategies are not just about learning, but also about providing support to individuals who are facing new educational challenges, such as using a new computer program or starting a new project.

translations.source: Majukwaa yanaweza kuwa dhahiri na pia halisi, kwa maneno mengine, mwalimu ni aina ya jukwaa lakini pia ndivyo kilivyo kile kijitu cha karatasi katika Microsoft Office.
translations.reference: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
translations.hypothesis: Platforms can be both visible and invisible; in other words, a platform is a type of tool, but it can also refer to the paper-like interface in Microsoft Office.

translations.source: Majukwaa Pepe yamewekwa ndani ya programu kwa kusudi la kuhoji, kushawishi, na kuelezea taratibu ambazo huenda zilikuwa changamoto kubwa kwa mwanafunzi kushughulikia peke yake.
translations.reference: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
translations.hypothesis: The "Pepe" platforms are integrated into the program to facilitate questioning, persuasion, and the explanation of procedures that may have been challenging for students to handle on their own.

translations.source: Watoto huwekwa kwenye Huduma ya Malezi kwa sababu nyingine nyingi ambazo huanzia kutelekezwa hadi kudhulumiwa na hata unyang’anyi.
translations.reference: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
translations.hypothesis: Children are placed in foster care for a variety of reasons, ranging from neglect and abuse to abandonment and even exploitation.

translations.source: Hakuna mtoto anayepaswa kukua katika mazingira ambayo hayaelimishi, huyajali, hayafundishi, lakini wanafanya hivyo.
translations.reference: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
translations.hypothesis: No child should grow up in an environment that is neglectful, abusive, or unsupportive.

translations.source: Tunadhania Mfumo wa Huduma ya Kulea kuwa eneo la usalama kwa watoto hawa.
translations.reference: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
translations.hypothesis: We anticipate that the childcare facility will be a safe environment for these children.

translations.source: Makazi ya watoto yanastahili kutoa makao salama, walezi wenye upendo, elimu imara, na mfumo wa afya unaoaminika.
translations.reference: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
translations.hypothesis: Children's homes should provide a safe and secure environment, loving caregivers, a strong educational program, and a reliable healthcare system.

translations.source: Makazi ya watoto yanastahili kutoa mahitaji haya yote ambayo yalikosekana nyumbani walikotolewa awali.
translations.reference: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
translations.hypothesis: The children's home should be able to provide all of these necessities that were lacking at the previous home.

translations.source: Mtandao unachanganya vitu vya mawasiliano ya kundi la watu na ya kati ya mtu na mtu.
translations.reference: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
translations.hypothesis: The network combines elements of both group and one-on-one communication.

translations.source: Tabia za kipekee za mtandao hupelekea vipimo zaidi kuhusu matumizi na mbinu za kuridhisha.
translations.reference: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
translations.hypothesis: The unique characteristics of the network enable more detailed insights into usage patterns and effective strategies.

translations.source: Kwa mfano, "kujifunza" na "ushirikiano" kunapendekezwa kama vichochezi muhimu kwa matumizi ya mtandao (James na wengine, 1995).
translations.reference: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
translations.hypothesis: For example, "learning" and "collaboration" are suggested as key drivers for internet use (James and others, 1995).

translations.source: Kushiriki kwa kibinafsi na "mahusiano endelezi" pia yalitambuliwa na Eighmey na McCord (1998) kama vipengele vipya vya motisha walipichunguza mjibizo wa hadhira katika tovuti.
translations.reference: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
translations.hypothesis: Eighmey and McCord (1998) also identified "personal engagement" and "ongoing communication" as new elements of motivation when they studied audience interaction on a website.

translations.source: Matumizi ya video za kurekodi imesababisha uvumbuzi muhimu katika tafsiri ya sauti ndogo, kusongeshwa kwa uso ambao hudumu sekunde ndogo kadhaa.
translations.reference: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
translations.hypothesis: The use of video recording technology has led to a significant advancement in the field of speech recognition, specifically in the development of facial expressions that last for a few seconds.

translations.source: Hususan, inadaiwa kuwa mtu anaweza kutambua ikiwa mtu anadanganya kwa kufasiri ishara ndogondogo kwa njia sahihi.
translations.reference: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
translations.hypothesis: Specifically, it is claimed that a person can identify when someone is lying by correctly interpreting subtle cues.

translations.source: Oliver Sacks, katika gazeti lake Hotuba ya Rais, alionyesha namna watu ambao hawawezi kuelewa hotuba kutokana na uharibifu wa ubongo hata hivyo wana uwezo kwa kutathmini ukweli kwa usahihi.
translations.reference: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
translations.hypothesis: In his article, "The President's Speech," Oliver Sacks illustrated how individuals who are unable to understand speech due to brain damage still possess the ability to accurately assess the truthfulness of what they hear.

translations.source: Hata anapendekeza kwamba uwezo kama huo wa kufasiri tabia za binadamu unaweza kushirikishwa wanyama kama vile mbwa wa kufugwa.
translations.reference: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.
translations.hypothesis: He also suggests that the ability to interpret human behavior could be applied to animals, such as dogs.

translations.source: Utafiti wa karne ya ishirini umeonyesha kwamba kuna makundi mawili ya utofauti wa jeni: fiche na zilizoelezewa.
translations.reference: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
translations.hypothesis: Research in the 20th century has shown that there are two distinct types of genetic variation: those that are easily observable and those that are not.

translations.source: Mabadiliko huongeza tofauti za kimaumbile, na uchaguzi huyaondoa katika mkusanyiko wa tofauti zilizoonyeshwa.
translations.reference: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
translations.hypothesis: The changes increase the degree of differentiation, and the selections remove these from the set of observed differences.

translations.source: Mabadiliko ya uchangaji ya utengaji na uchanganyaji tena huku na huko kati ya vidimbwi hivyo viwili kwa kila kizazi.
translations.reference: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
translations.hypothesis: The exchange of genetic material between these two populations has occurred repeatedly over time.

translations.source: Nje kwenye savana, ni vigumu kwa wanyama wakuu waliyo na mfumo wa kuyeyusha chakula tumboni kama wa binadamu kutoshelezeza mahitaji ya tindikali-za-amino zao kutoka kwa vifaa vya mimea vilivyomo
translations.reference: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
translations.hypothesis: In the savanna, it is difficult for large animals with digestive systems similar to humans to obtain sufficient amounts of essential amino acids from plant-based food sources.

translations.source: Waaidha, kukosa kufanya hivyo kuna matokeo mazito: udidimiaji wa ukuaji, utapiamlo, na hatimaye kifo.
translations.reference: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
translations.hypothesis: Malnutrition, if left untreated, has serious consequences: stunted growth, wasting, and ultimately, death.

translations.source: Rasilimali za mimea zinazofikiwa kwa urahisi zingekuwa protini zinazopatikana katika majani na kunde, lakini hizi ni ngumu kwa wale wa kundi la mammalia wa hali ya juu kama sisi kusaga isipokuwa kama zimepikwa.
translations.reference: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
translations.hypothesis: Easily accessible plant-based protein sources would be found in leafy greens and legumes, but these are difficult for mammals, including ourselves, to digest without cooking.

translations.source: Kwa kulinganisha, vyakula vya wanyama (siafu, mchwa, mayai) si kwamba vinameng’enywa kwa urahisi tu, lakini pia hutoa protini zenye kiwango kikubwa ambazo zina asidi muhimu za amino.
translations.reference: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
translations.hypothesis: In contrast, animal products (meat, fish, eggs) are not just easily obtained, but also provide a high level of protein, which contains essential amino acids.

translations.source: Mambo yote yakizingatiwa, hatupaswi kushangaa kama wahenga wetu walitatua “shida yao ya protini” kwa njia sawa na zile nyani wa savanna hufanya leo.
translations.reference: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
translations.hypothesis: Considering everything, we shouldn't be surprised that our ancestors faced a similar "protein problem" as the animals in the savanna do today.

translations.source: Ukatizaji wa usingizi ni mchakato wa kuamka kimakusudi wakati wa usingizi wako wa kawaida na kupatwa na usingizi muda mfupi baadaye (dakika 10-60).
translations.reference: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
translations.hypothesis: Wake-up naps are a deliberate act of waking up during your normal sleep period and then experiencing a brief period of sleep (10-60 minutes) afterward.

translations.source: Hili linaweza kufanywa kwa kutumia saa ya kengele isiyo na kelele kubwa sana ili kukufanya upate fahamu bila kukuamsha kabisa.
translations.reference: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
translations.hypothesis: This can be achieved by using a silent alarm clock that doesn't produce a loud sound, so that you can be alerted without being fully awakened.

translations.source: Kama utajipata ukiweka upya saa ya kengele katika usingizi wako, inaweza kuwekwa upande mwingine wa chumba, ili kukulazimu kuondoka kitandani kuizima.
translations.reference: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
translations.hypothesis: If you find yourself repeatedly setting your alarm clock in the middle of the night, it might be helpful to move it to the other side of the room, so you have to get out of bed to turn it off.

translations.source: Chaguo zingine za midundobayolojia huhusisha unywaji mwingi (hususan wa maji au chai, dawa maarufu) kabla ya kulala, hali inayomlazimu mtu kuamka ili kwenda haja ndogo.
translations.reference: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
translations.hypothesis: Other physiological factors include excessive fluid intake (particularly water or tea, a common remedy), which can necessitate waking up to use the restroom.

translations.source: Kiwango cha amani ya ndani ambayo mtu humiliki huhusiana kinyume na kiwango cha mkazo ndani ya mwili na roho yake.
translations.reference: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
translations.hypothesis: The level of inner peace a person experiences is inversely related to the level of stress within their body and mind.

translations.source: Kadiri mvuto ulivyo chini, ndivyo nguvu za maisha zilizoko zilivyo chanya. Kila mtu ana uwezo wa kupata amani na kuridhika zaidi.
translations.reference: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
translations.hypothesis: The greater the inner attraction, the stronger the positive life force. Everyone has the potential to achieve greater peace and contentment.

translations.source: Kila mtu anaweza kupata uelewa. Kitu kimoja kinachosimama njiani mwa lengo hili ni wasiwasi na uhasi wetu wenyewe.
translations.reference: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
translations.hypothesis: Everyone can achieve understanding. One obstacle to this goal is our own anxiety and uncertainty.

translations.source: Ubuddha wa Tibetani una msingi wa mafundisho ya Buddha, lakini ulipanuliwa na njia ya mahayana ya upendo na mbinu nyingi za kutoka kwa Yoga ya India.
translations.reference: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
translations.hypothesis: Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of the Buddha, but it has been expanded by the Mahayana tradition of loving-kindness and numerous techniques from Indian Yoga.

translations.source: Katika kanuni, Ubudha wa Kitibeti ni rahisi sana. Una Yoga ya Kundalini, kutafakari na njia ya upendo unaokumbatia yote.
translations.reference: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
translations.hypothesis: In summary, Tibetan Buddhism is quite simple. It involves Kundalini yoga, meditation, and a path of universal love and compassion.

translations.source: Kupitia Yoga ya Kundalini, nguvu za Kundalini (nguvu za mwangaza) huibushwa kupitia mkao wa yoga, mazoezi ya kupumua, urudiaji maneno au sauti na taswira.
translations.reference: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
translations.hypothesis: Through Kundalini Yoga, the energy of Kundalini (the energy of enlightenment) is awakened and channeled through specific yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantra repetition, or visualization.

translations.source: Kitovu cha fikira za Tibet ni Yoga ya Uungu. Kupitia taswira ya miungu mbalimbali njia za nishati zinasafishwa, chakra zinaamilishwa na fahamu ya wongofu inaamshwa.
translations.reference: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
translations.hypothesis: The core of Tibetan thought is Yoga of the Divine. Through visualizations of various deities, energy channels are cleared, chakras are activated, and the mind is purified.

translations.source: Ujerumani ilikuwa adui wa kawaida katika Vita vya Pili vya Dunia, hivyo kupelekea ushirikiano wa USSR na Marekani. Kwa kumalizika kwa vita mgongano wa mfumo, mchakato na utamaduni vilipelekea kutengana kwa nchi.
translations.reference: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
translations.hypothesis: Germany was a common enemy in World War II, leading to an alliance between the USSR and the United States. With the end of the war, the conflict between ideologies and cultures led to the division of the country.

translations.source: Na miaka mbili ya kumalizika kwa vita, washirika wa zamani waligeuka kuwa maadui na Vita Baridi vikaanza.
translations.reference: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.
translations.hypothesis: Two years after the end of the war, former allies became enemies, and the Cold War began.

translations.source: Ilikuwa idumu kwa miaka 40 ijayo na ingepigwa kwa kweli na vikosi vya kiwakala, katika nyanja za vita toka Afrika hadi Asia, katika Afghanistani, Kuba na sehemu nyingine nyingi
translations.reference: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
translations.hypothesis: It would last for the next 40 years and would be truly tested by the forces of various agencies, in conflicts ranging from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba, and many other places.

translations.source: Kufikia Septemba 17, 1939, ulinzi wa Kipolishi ulivunjwa, na tumaini la pekee lilikuwa kurudi na kujipanga tena kwa darajakuu la Kiromania.
translations.reference: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.
translations.hypothesis: By September 17, 1939, Polish defenses had been breached, and the sole hope was to return and reorganize the Polish army.

translations.source: Hata hivyo, mipango hii ilipitwa na wakati usiku mmoja, wakati zaidi ya askari 800,000 kutoka Jeshi Jekundu la Umoja wa Kisovyeti lilipoingia na kuunda mipaka ya Belarusiani na Ukreini baada ya kuvamia maeneo ya mashariki mwa Polandi kwa kukiuka Mkataba wa Amani wa Riga, Mapatano ya Kisovyeti-Polishi Yasiyo ya Uchokozi, na mikataba mingine ya kimataifa, pande mbili na pande nyingi.
translations.reference: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
translations.hypothesis: However, this plan was quickly abandoned one night when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet Red Army invaded, establishing the borders of Belarus and Ukraine after violating the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international agreements.

translations.source: Kutumia meli kusafirisha bidhaa kwa kiasi kikubwa ilikuwa njia bora zaidi ya kusafirisha halaiki ya watu na bidhaa nyingi baharini.
translations.reference: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
translations.hypothesis: Using ships to transport goods in large quantities was the best way to transport people and a large volume of goods by sea.

translations.source: Kazi ya Jeshi la wanamaji kwa kiasili imekuwa ni kuhakikisha kuwa nchi yako ina uwezo wa kusafirisha watu na bidhaa zako, wakati huo huo, kuzuia uwezo wa adui wako wa kuhamisha watu wake na bidhaa.
translations.reference: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
translations.hypothesis: The primary role of naval forces is to ensure that your country has the ability to transport people and goods, while also preventing the enemy from doing the same.

translations.source: Mojawapo ya mifano maarufu ya hivi karibuni ni kampeni ya Kaskazini mwa Atlantiki ya Vita Vikuu vya Pili vya Dunia. Wamarekani walikuwa wakijaribu kusafirisha watu na vifaa kupitia Bahari ya Atlantiki ili kuwasaidia Waingereza.
translations.reference: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
translations.hypothesis: One of the most recent and well-known examples is the North Atlantic campaign during World War II. The Americans were attempting to transport people and supplies across the Atlantic Ocean to assist the British.

translations.source: Wakati huo huo, askari wa majeshi ya Ujerumani, kwa kutumia nyambizi, yalikuwa yakijaribu kuzuia trafiki hii.
translations.reference: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
translations.hypothesis: At the same time, German soldiers were attempting to control the traffic using barricades.

translations.source: Ikiwa Muungano ungeshindwa, pengine Ujerumani ingeweza kushinda Uingereza kama vile ilivyokuwa imeshinda Uropa.
translations.reference: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
translations.hypothesis: If the alliance had failed, Germany might have been able to conquer Britain, just as it had conquered Europe.

translations.source: Yaelekea mbuzi walianza kufugwa takriban miaka 10,000 iliyopita katika Milima ya Zagrosi ya Irani.
translations.reference: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
translations.hypothesis: It is believed that goats were first domesticated approximately 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.

translations.source: Tamaduni na makabila ya kale yalianza kuwafuga kwa ufikiaji rahisi wa maziwa, nywele, nyama, na ngozi.
translations.reference: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
translations.hypothesis: Ancient cultures and tribes began to domesticate animals for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and hides.

translations.source: Kijumla, mbuzi wa nyumbani walianza kufugwa kwa makundi yaliyotangatanga milimani au maeneo mengine ya malisho, huku yakisimamiwa na walinzi ambao mara nyingi walikuwa watoto au vijana wachanga, sawia na wachungaji wanaofahamika sana. Mbinu hizi za ufugaji bado zinatumika hata leo.
translations.reference: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
translations.hypothesis: In general, domestic goats were raised in small herds on mountain slopes or in other grazing areas, with the animals being tended by herders who were often children or young adults, alongside experienced shepherds. These herding practices are still in use today.

translations.source: Magari yanayosukokotwana farasi yalijengwa huko Uingereza mapema kama karne ya 16.
translations.reference: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
translations.hypothesis: Horse-drawn carriages were first developed in England in the early 16th century.

translations.source: Ingawa njia za magari zilisheheni magogo sambamba ya miti, zilihuruhusu farasi kuzivuta kwa kasi zaidi na kuvuta mizigo mikubwa kiasi kwa barabara mbaya za siku.
translations.reference: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
translations.hypothesis: While the use of horse-drawn carriages provided a means of transportation, they also allowed horses to pull heavier loads at a faster pace, making them suitable for navigating the rough roads of the time.

translations.source: Nguzomlalo zilianzishwa mapema kiasi ili kushikilia reli mahali pake. Hata hivyo, kadiri muda ulivyoendelea iligunduliwa kwamba reli hizo zingefanya kazi bora zaidi ikiwa kipande cha chuma kingewekelewa juu.
translations.reference: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
translations.hypothesis: The initial supports were constructed early on to keep the tracks in place. However, as time went on, it was discovered that the tracks would function better if a metal plate was placed on top of them.

translations.source: Hii ilikuja kuwa desturi, lakini chuma kilisababisha kuharibika kwa magurudumu ya mbao ya magari ya kukokotwa.
translations.reference: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
translations.hypothesis: This became a common occurrence, but the metal caused the wooden wheels of the hand-pulled carriages to break.

translations.source: Hatimaye, magurudumu ya mbao yalibadilishwa na magurudumu ya vyuma. Mnamo 1767, reli za kwanza za vyuma kamili zilianzishwa.
translations.reference: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
translations.hypothesis: Eventually, the wooden wheels were replaced with iron wheels. In 1767, the first complete iron railway was established.

translations.source: Namna yak kwanza ya uchukuzi iliyofahamika ni kutembea, binadaum walianza kutembea wima miaka milioni mbili iliyopita, baada ya kuibuka kwa wanadamu wima.
translations.reference: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).
translations.hypothesis: The first known form of transportation was walking, and humans began walking upright approximately two million years ago, after the emergence of our hominid ancestors.

translations.source: Watangulizi wao, Australopithecus hawakutembea wima kama kawaida.
translations.reference: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.
translations.hypothesis: Their predecessors, Australopithecus, did not walk upright like modern humans.

translations.source: Utaalamu wa bipedali unapatikana katika visukuku vya Australopithekasi kuanzia miaka milion 4.2 hadi 3.9 iliyopita, ingawa inawezekana kuwa Sahelanthropasi walitembea kwa miguu miwili takriban miaka milioni saba iliyopita.
translations.reference: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.
translations.hypothesis: Bipedalism, the ability to walk on two legs, is found in the fossil remains of Australopithecus, dating back from 4.2 to 3.9 million years ago. However, it is possible that Sahelanthropus was also capable of walking on two legs, approximately 7 million years ago.

translations.source: Tunaweza kuanza kuishi kama marafiki wazuri wa mazingira, tunaweza kujiunga na harakati za mazingira, na hata pia tunaweza kuwa wanaharakati ili kupunguza dhiki ya baadaye kwa kiwango fulani.
translations.reference: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.
translations.hypothesis: We can begin to live as good environmental friends, we can join environmental movements, and even become activists to mitigate future problems to some extent.
